            City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
            DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem), Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
            IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant), TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
            ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", SignInType = "NonInteractive", UserPrincipalName, UserId,
            AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
            IPAddress, Location, City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent,
            DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName), DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
            Browser = tostring(_dev.browser), IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
            TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType), ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    // ADFSSignInLogs: AD FS sign-ins reported by Microsoft Entra Connect Health (SignInType "AD FS"), as a complement.
    // They cover federated applications specific to AD FS; a federated sign-in to an Entra ID application also appears in SigninLogs.
    (
        ADFSSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _st = parse_json(Status)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "ADFSSignInLogs", SignInType = "AD FS", UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId,
            ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription = tostring(_st.additionalDetails), FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
            IPAddress, Location = "", City = "", AutonomousSystemNumber = "", ClientAppUsed = "", UserAgent,
            DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName), DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
            Browser = tostring(_dev.browser), IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
            TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType), ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement = "", RiskLevelDuringSignIn = "",
            SessionId = "", CorrelationId
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        EntraIdSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(LogonType contains "noninteractive", "NonInteractive", "Interactive")
        | where (SignInType == "Interactive" and not(_HasInteractive)) or (SignInType == "NonInteractive" and not(_HasNonInteractive))
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or AccountUpn =~ upn
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSignInEvents", SignInType, UserPrincipalName = AccountUpn,
            UserId = AccountObjectId, AppDisplayName = Application, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName,
            ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), ResultDescription = "", FailureReason = "", IPAddress, Location = Country, City,
            AutonomousSystemNumber = "", ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId = EntraIdDeviceId, OperatingSystem = OSPlatform,
            Browser, IsManaged = tostring(IsManaged == 1), IsCompliant = tostring(IsCompliant == 1), TrustType = DeviceTrustType,
            ConditionalAccessStatus = case(ConditionalAccessStatus == 0, "success", ConditionalAccessStatus == 1, "failure",
                ConditionalAccessStatus == 2, "notApplied", tostring(ConditionalAccessStatus)),
            AuthenticationRequirement,
            RiskLevelDuringSignIn = case(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 100, "high", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 50, "medium",
                RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 10, "low", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 0, "none", tostring(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)),
            SessionId, CorrelationId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
};
// Entra ID sign-ins of applications (service principals) and managed identities, normalized:
// - Sentinel: AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs and AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs;
// - Defender XDR: EntraIdSpnSignInEvents (IsManagedIdentity tells them apart), read only for the type the Sentinel
//   tables do not provide over the period (no duplicates in the unified portal).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks (Sentinel tables) are removed from the Defender XDR variant, which then reads only EntraIdSpnSignInEvents.
// Parameters: start, end, app (AppId, ServicePrincipalId or name; empty = all), ip (empty = all).
let _SpnSignins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, app:string, ip:string) {
    let _HasSpn = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        // @sentinel-only:begin
        (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        // @sentinel-only:end
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    let _HasMi = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        // @sentinel-only:begin
        (AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        // @sentinel-only:end
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    union isfuzzy=true
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs", SignInType = "Service principal", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = ClientCredentialType,
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = AADTenantId
    ),
    (
        AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(app) or AppId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs", SignInType = "Managed identity", ServicePrincipalName,
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, Credential = "Managed identity",
            AppOwnerTenantId, HomeTenantId = TenantId
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        EntraIdSpnSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Managed identity", "Service principal")
        | where (SignInType == "Service principal" and not(_HasSpn)) or (SignInType == "Managed identity" and not(_HasMi))
        | where isempty(app) or ApplicationId == app or ServicePrincipalId == app or ServicePrincipalName =~ app or Application =~ app
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSpnSignInEvents", SignInType, ServicePrincipalName = coalesce(ServicePrincipalName, Application),
            ServicePrincipalId, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), IPAddress, Location = Country,
            Credential = iff(IsManagedIdentity, "Managed identity", iff(IsConfidentialClient, "Confidential client", "Public client")),
            AppOwnerTenantId = "", HomeTenantId = ResourceTenantId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
    // Application origin: Microsoft publisher, application of this tenant, or application of another tenant (third-party multi-tenant)
    | extend AppOrigin = case(AppOwnerTenantId in ("f8cdef31-a31e-4b4a-93e4-5f571e91255a", "72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47"), "Microsoft (first-party)",
        SignInType == "Managed identity", "Tenant managed identity",
        isempty(AppOwnerTenantId), "",
        AppOwnerTenantId == HomeTenantId, "Tenant application",
        "Other-tenant application")
};
// All log sources where an IP address appears, mapped to common columns:
// TimeGenerated, Source, EventType (EventID, ActionType or operation), Host, AuthBy, Account, Detail.
// - Host: device the event is about (the target when the IP is the source, the IP's device when it is the target),
//   never the domain controller that only validated credentials.
// - AuthBy: domain controller (or local device) that validated the credentials (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776, Defender for Identity).
// Sources: Entra ID (users and applications), Entra ID audit, Microsoft Graph, Windows, Defender for Endpoint and
// Defender for Identity, Sysmon 3, share access (5140, 5145), Microsoft 365, Azure, firewall and proxy (CEF, Azure
// Firewall, ASIM), email, Linux (Syslog).
// @requires: win_security, sysmon, signins, spn_signins
let _IpEvents = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Signins(start, end, ip, "")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Successful sign-in", strcat("Failed sign-in ", ResultType)),
            Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = AppDisplayName
    ),
    (
        _SpnSignins(start, end, "", ip)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Entra ID (", SignInType, ")"), EventType = iff(Succeeded, "Successful sign-in", strcat("Failed sign-in ", ResultType)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(ServicePrincipalName), Detail = ResourceDisplayName
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        AuditLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress) == ip or tostring(InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress) == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AuditLogs", EventType = OperationName, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))),
            Detail = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
    ),
    (
        MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs", EventType = strcat(RequestMethod, " ", tostring(ResponseStatusCode)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId),
            Detail = replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}", "{id}")
    ),
    // Sentinel only: legacy Azure AD Graph, Entra ID Protection risk detections (AD FS sign-ins: via _Signins)
    (
        AADGraphActivityLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AADGraphActivityLogs", EventType = strcat(RequestMethod, " ", tostring(ResponseStatusCode)),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId),
            Detail = replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}", "{id}")
    ),
    (
        AADUserRiskEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AADUserRiskEvents", EventType = strcat("Risk ", RiskLevel, " · ", RiskState),
            Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(UserPrincipalName), Detail = strcat(RiskEventType, " · ", DetectionTimingType)
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(start, end, dynamic([]), ip)
        | where IpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, EventType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName),
            Host = TargetHost, AuthBy = AuthAuthority, Account = coalesce(TargetSam, SubjectSam),
            Detail = case(EventID in (5140, 5145), strcat(ShareName, " ", RelativeTargetName, " · ", ObjectAccess), LogonTypeName)
    ),
    (
        _Sysmon(start, end, dynamic([3]), ip)
        | where DestinationIp == ip or SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Sysmon 3", EventType = iff(Initiated == "true", "Outbound connection", "Inbound connection"),
            Host = Computer, AuthBy = "", Account = UserSam,
            Detail = strcat(ProcessFile, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", DestinationPort, iff(isempty(DestinationHostname), "", strcat(" (", DestinationHostname, ")")))
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip or LocalIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Detail = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " → ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort))
    ),
    (
        DeviceLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RemoteIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = DeviceName, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountName), Detail = LogonType
    ),
    (
        IdentityLogonEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip or DestinationIPAddress == ip
        // Source IP: the relevant device is the target (the destination DC only validated); destination IP: the source device
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityLogonEvents", EventType = ActionType,
            Host = iff(IPAddress == ip, TargetDeviceName, DeviceName),
            AuthBy = iff(IPAddress == ip, DestinationDeviceName, ""),
            Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityQueryEvents", EventType = strcat(ActionType, " ", QueryType), Host = DeviceName,
            AuthBy = DestinationDeviceName, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Protocol, " ", QueryTarget)
    ),
    (
        IdentityDirectoryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "IdentityDirectoryEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = coalesce(TargetDeviceName, DeviceName),
            AuthBy = DestinationDeviceName, Account = tolower(coalesce(AccountUpn, AccountName)), Detail = strcat(Application, " ", Protocol)
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        ASimAuthenticationEventLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or TargetIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimAuthenticationEventLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = strcat(EventType, " ", EventResult),
            Host = iff(SrcIpAddr == ip, coalesce(TargetHostname, DvcHostname), SrcHostname), AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(TargetUsername), Detail = strcat(LogonProtocol, " ", LogonMethod)
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        CloudAppEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "CloudAppEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(RawEventData.UserId), AccountDisplayName)), Detail = Application
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where ClientIP has ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "OfficeActivity", EventType = Operation, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(UserId), Detail = OfficeWorkload
    ),
    (
        AzureActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where CallerIpAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", EventType = OperationNameValue, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(Caller), Detail = ResourceGroup
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity),
            Host = iff(SourceIP == ip, DestinationHostName, SourceHostName), AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(coalesce(SourceUserName, DestinationUserName)), Detail = strcat(SourceIP, " → ", DestinationIP, ":", tostring(DestinationPort))
    ),
    (
        ASimNetworkSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or DstIpAddr == ip or SrcNatIpAddr == ip or DstNatIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimNetworkSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DvcAction, EventResult),
            Host = iff(DstIpAddr == ip or DstNatIpAddr == ip, SrcHostname, DstHostname), AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(SrcUsername),
            Detail = strcat(SrcIpAddr, " → ", DstIpAddr, ":", tostring(DstPortNumber))
    ),
    (
        ASimWebSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SrcIpAddr == ip or DstIpAddr == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimWebSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), EventType = coalesce(DvcAction, EventResult),
            Host = SrcHostname, AuthBy = "", Account = tolower(SrcUsername), Detail = Url
    ),
    (
        AZFWNetworkRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip or DestinationIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWNetworkRule", EventType = Action, Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = strcat(SourceIp, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", tostring(DestinationPort), " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        AZFWApplicationRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWApplicationRule", EventType = Action, Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = coalesce(TargetUrl, Fqdn)
    ),
    // Azure Firewall, continued: DNAT, threat intelligence and DNS proxy
    (
        AZFWNatRule
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip or DestinationIp == ip or TranslatedIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWNatRule", EventType = strcat("DNAT ", Rule), Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = strcat(SourceIp, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", tostring(DestinationPort), " ⇒ ", TranslatedIp, ":", tostring(TranslatedPort), " ", Protocol)
    ),
    (
        AZFWThreatIntel
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip or DestinationIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWThreatIntel", EventType = strcat("Threat intel ", Action), Host = "", AuthBy = "", Account = "",
            Detail = strcat(SourceIp, " → ", DestinationIp, ":", tostring(DestinationPort), " · ", ThreatDescription)
    ),
    (
        AZFWDnsQuery
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SourceIp == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWDnsQuery", EventType = strcat("DNS ", QueryType, " ", ResponseCode), Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = "", Detail = QueryName
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SenderIPv4 == ip or SenderIPv6 == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailEvents", EventType = DeliveryAction, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(SenderFromAddress), Detail = Subject
    ),
    (
        UrlClickEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where IPAddress == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "UrlClickEvents", EventType = ActionType, Host = "", AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(AccountUpn), Detail = Url
    )
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    , (
        Syslog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where SyslogMessage has ip or HostIP == ip
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Syslog (", ProcessName, ")"), EventType = SeverityLevel, Host = Computer, AuthBy = "",
            Account = tolower(extract(@"(?:Accepted|Failed) \S+ for (?:invalid user )?(\S+) from", 1, SyslogMessage)),
            Detail = substring(SyslogMessage, 0, 300)
    )
    // @sentinel-only:end
    | extend Host = tolower(Host), AuthBy = tolower(AuthBy)
};
// Entity roles (devices, IPs, accounts): separates "where the event is logged" from "where the entity is used"
// and flags entities that skew a pivot (domain controller, NAT, proxy, service account...).
// Three combined sources:
// 1. automatic domain controller (DC) detection: hosts emitting 4768 (only a KDC does), LDAP targets seen by
//    Defender for Identity, devices accepting Kerberos connections (port 88) according to Defender for Endpoint;
// 2. Sentinel watchlist "EasyPivotRoles" (columns Entity, Type, Role, Note), template in watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv;
//    Type values (case-insensitive): Machine/Host/Device, IP/CIDR/Subnet, Account/User (French values still accepted);
// 3. accounts: IdentityInfo (Entra ID roles, privileged AD groups, service account, Defender for Identity tags)
//    and reserved names (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync).
// Each function takes the reference time `at` and looks at the preceding day (14 days for IdentityInfo).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks are removed from the Defender XDR variant (tables missing in Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h): lowercase short name (FQDN, NetBIOS, machine account "PC01$" -> "pc01"); empty for an IP address.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a): SAM name of an account, from "DOMAIN\name", "name@domain" or "name".
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(name, role): "dc01 [DC]", to annotate lists (make_set) without adding a column.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b): joins two role labels, skipping empty ones.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(SAM name): category inferred from the name alone.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Machine account",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "System account",
        sam == "krbtgt", "KDC account (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Entra Connect sync",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Built-in administrator",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at): devices (and IPs) that behave like domain controllers.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "LDAP target (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepts Kerberos on port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at): MachineKey (short name), MachineRole ("DC, File server"), MachineRoleBasis (evidence).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at): Ip (exact address or CIDR range), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at): known roles of an address, including membership in a watchlist CIDR range.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at): AccountKey (lowercase SAM name or UPN), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Entra ID role assigned"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Privileged AD group", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Service account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Sensitive account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Honeytoken account", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};
let Kind = case(
    Value matches regex @"^(127\.|::1$)", "Loopback",
    ipv4_is_private(Value), "Private (RFC 1918)",
    Value matches regex @"^(169\.254\.|fe80:)", "Link-local",
    Value matches regex @"^(100\.(6[4-9]|[7-9]\d|1[01]\d|12[0-7])\.)", "Carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT)",
    Value matches regex @"^(fc|fd)", "Private (IPv6 ULA)",
    "Public");
let Owners = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(Machine:string, Basis:string)[]),
    (DeviceNetworkInfo | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp) | where IPAddresses has Value
        | summarize by Machine = tolower(DeviceName) | extend Basis = "Network adapter (DeviceNetworkInfo)"),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp) | where ComputerIP == Value or ComputerPrivateIPs has Value
        | summarize by Machine = tolower(Computer) | extend Basis = "Azure Monitor agent (Heartbeat)"),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp) | where PublicIP == Value
        | summarize by Machine = tolower(DeviceName) | extend Basis = "Public egress IP (DeviceInfo)");
let Seen = _IpEvents(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, Value)
    | summarize Events = count(), Accounts = dcountif(Account, isnotempty(Account) and Account != "-"),
        Machines = dcountif(Host, isnotempty(Host)), Sources = make_set(Source, 30),
        FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated);
Seen
| extend Ip = Value, Kind, KnownRole = _IpRoleOf(Value, EndTimestamp),
    OwnerMachines = toscalar(Owners | summarize make_set(strcat(Machine, " (", Basis, ")"), 20)),
    OwnerCount = toscalar(Owners | summarize dcount(Machine))
| extend Assessment = case(
    isnotempty(KnownRole), strcat("Known role: ", KnownRole, ". Pivots on this IP return its infrastructure traffic."),
    OwnerCount > 3, "Held by several devices (NAT, VPN, reassigned IP): pivot on the device rather than the IP.",
    Accounts > 20, "Seen with many accounts: likely shared IP (NAT, proxy, VPN, Citrix).",
    Events == 0, "No events in the window: widen the window or check coverage (IP-S0).",
    "No known role and no sign of sharing.")
| project Ip, Kind, KnownRole, Assessment, OwnerMachines, Accounts, Machines, Events, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Sources

rules.name: Domains and URLs linked to the IP
rules.description: Domain names and URLs associated with the IP, one row per domain: workstation connections to the IP with the requested URL (DeviceNetworkEvents), DNS responses that returned the IP seen by Defender for Endpoint (DeviceEvents, DnsQueryResponse) and, in Sentinel, by Windows DNS servers (DnsEvents), ASIM normalized DNS logs (ASimDnsActivityLogs) and Sysmon 22, plus web requests to the IP seen by the proxy or firewall (ASimWebSessionLogs, CommonSecurityLog). Used to go from a destination IP (alert, firewall) to the domains to pivot on next (DM-P1 to DM-P4), and to spot other domains hosted on the same IP.

reading.decisive: Recent, typosquatted or unrelated domain, resolved to the IP by only one or two workstations.
reading.context: Many distinct domains on the same IP (shared hosting, phishing infrastructure); URL with a download path.
reading.noise: CDN or public cloud IP (Azure, AWS, Akamai, Cloudflare) shared by hundreds of legitimate domains.

rules.query:
// [IP-P7] Domains and URLs linked to the IP — Pivot / IP address
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 24h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // default: 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

// Common URL / domain functions.
// _Host: host of a URL or a name (adds a scheme if missing so that parse_url works).
// _InDomain: true if the host is the domain or one of its subdomains.
let _Host = (u:string) { tolower(tostring(parse_url(iff(u contains "://", u, strcat("http://", u))).Host)) };
let _InDomain = (h:string, d:string) { isnotempty(d) and (h == d or h endswith strcat(".", d)) };
// Sysmon events (Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational log) normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// Event (Azure Monitor agent, EventData as XML) or WindowsEvent (event forwarding, EventData as JSON).
// Parameters: start, end, ids (EventIDs, empty = all), term (text pre-filter on event data and device name, empty = none).
// Sysmon columns (Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, User, Hashes, TargetFilename, ImageLoaded, TargetObject, Details,
// SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname, QueryName, QueryResults...) and derived columns:
// Contents (Zone.Identifier stream of event 15: HostUrl and ReferrerUrl of the download).
// ProcessFile, ParentFile, TargetFile (lowercase file names), UserSam, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, RegistryEventType, EventName.
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// Returns nothing unless Sysmon is installed with a configuration that logs the requested EventIDs.
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _SysmonEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 1, "Process created",
        id == 2, "File creation time changed",
        id == 3, "Network connection",
        id == 5, "Process terminated",
        id == 6, "Driver loaded",
        id == 7, "Image (DLL) loaded",
        id == 8, "Remote thread created",
        id == 10, "Process accessed",
        id == 11, "File created",
        id == 12, "Registry key created or deleted",
        id == 13, "Registry value set",
        id == 14, "Registry key or value renamed",
        id == 15, "File stream created (ADS, Mark of the Web)",
        id == 17, "Named pipe created",
        id == 18, "Named pipe connected",
        id == 22, "DNS query",
        id == 23, "File deleted (archived)",
        id == 25, "Process tampering",
        id == 26, "File deleted",
        id == 29, "Executable detected",
        strcat("Sysmon ", tostring(id)))
};
let _Sysmon = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true

        Event

            ParentProcessGuid = extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessGuid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Hashes = extract(@'<Data Name="Hashes">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),

            Signed = extract(@'<Data Name="Signed">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),

            Details = extract(@'<Data Name="Details">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),

            SourceIp = extract(@'<Data Name="SourceIp">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            SourcePort = extract(@'<Data Name="SourcePort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            SourceHostname = extract(@'<Data Name="SourceHostname">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            DestinationIp = extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationIp">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            DestinationPort = extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            DestinationHostname = extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationHostname">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            QueryName = extract(@'<Data Name="QueryName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            QueryResults = extract(@'<Data Name="QueryResults">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            QueryStatus = extract(@'<Data Name="QueryStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            SourceImage = extract(@'<Data Name="SourceImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetImage = extract(@'<Data Name="TargetImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            GrantedAccess = extract(@'<Data Name="GrantedAccess">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Archived = extract(@'<Data Name="Archived">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),

        | extend SourceTable = "Event"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            Image = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Image), extract(@'<Data Name="Image">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CurrentDirectory = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CurrentDirectory), extract(@'<Data Name="CurrentDirectory">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessGuid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessGuid), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessGuid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessId), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            User = coalesce(tostring(EventData.User), extract(@'<Data Name="User">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentImage = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentImage), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentCommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentCommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentCommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessGuid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessGuid), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessGuid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Hashes = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Hashes), extract(@'<Data Name="Hashes">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Hash = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Hash), extract(@'<Data Name="Hash">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            OriginalFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.OriginalFileName), extract(@'<Data Name="OriginalFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Company = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Company), extract(@'<Data Name="Company">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IntegrityLevel = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IntegrityLevel), extract(@'<Data Name="IntegrityLevel">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetFilename = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetFilename), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetFilename">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CreationUtcTime = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CreationUtcTime), extract(@'<Data Name="CreationUtcTime">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ImageLoaded = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ImageLoaded), extract(@'<Data Name="ImageLoaded">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Signed = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Signed), extract(@'<Data Name="Signed">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Signature = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Signature), extract(@'<Data Name="Signature">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetObject = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetObject), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetObject">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Details = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Details), extract(@'<Data Name="Details">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            EventType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.EventType), extract(@'<Data Name="EventType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Protocol = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Protocol), extract(@'<Data Name="Protocol">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Initiated = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Initiated), extract(@'<Data Name="Initiated">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SourceIp = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SourceIp), extract(@'<Data Name="SourceIp">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SourcePort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SourcePort), extract(@'<Data Name="SourcePort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SourceHostname = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SourceHostname), extract(@'<Data Name="SourceHostname">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            DestinationIp = coalesce(tostring(EventData.DestinationIp), extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationIp">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            DestinationPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.DestinationPort), extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            DestinationHostname = coalesce(tostring(EventData.DestinationHostname), extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationHostname">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            QueryName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.QueryName), extract(@'<Data Name="QueryName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            QueryResults = coalesce(tostring(EventData.QueryResults), extract(@'<Data Name="QueryResults">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            QueryStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.QueryStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="QueryStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SourceImage = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SourceImage), extract(@'<Data Name="SourceImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetImage = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetImage), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            GrantedAccess = coalesce(tostring(EventData.GrantedAccess), extract(@'<Data Name="GrantedAccess">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Archived = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Archived), extract(@'<Data Name="Archived">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Contents = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Contents), extract(@'<Data Name="Contents">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"

    | extend Hashes = coalesce(Hashes, Hash)
    | extend ProcessFile = tolower(tostring(split(Image, @"\")[-1])), ParentFile = tolower(tostring(split(ParentImage, @"\")[-1])),
        TargetFile = tolower(tostring(split(TargetFilename, @"\")[-1])), UserSam = tolower(tostring(split(User, @"\")[-1])),
        SHA256 = tolower(extract(@"SHA256=([0-9A-Fa-f]{64})", 1, Hashes)), SHA1 = tolower(extract(@"SHA1=([0-9A-Fa-f]{40})", 1, Hashes)),
        MD5 = tolower(extract(@"MD5=([0-9A-Fa-f]{32})", 1, Hashes)), EventName = _SysmonEventName(EventID), RegistryEventType = EventType
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, EventID, EventName, Image, ProcessFile, CommandLine, CurrentDirectory, ProcessGuid, ProcessId,
        User, UserSam, ParentImage, ParentFile, ParentCommandLine, ParentProcessGuid, Hashes, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, OriginalFileName, Company,
        IntegrityLevel, TargetFilename, TargetFile, CreationUtcTime, ImageLoaded, Signed, Signature, TargetObject, Details, RegistryEventType,
        Protocol, Initiated, SourceIp, SourcePort, SourceHostname, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname, QueryName, QueryResults,
        QueryStatus, SourceImage, TargetImage, GrantedAccess, Archived, Contents
};
// @sentinel-only:end
union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where RemoteIP == Value and isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | project TimeGenerated, Domain = _Host(RemoteUrl), Url = iff(RemoteUrl contains "/", RemoteUrl, ""),
        Client = tolower(DeviceName), Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents"
),
(
    DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
    | where AdditionalFields has Value
    | extend AF = parse_json(tostring(AdditionalFields))
    | where tostring(AF.DnsQueryResult) has Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Domain = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", tostring(AF.DnsQueryString))), Url = "",
        Client = tolower(DeviceName), Source = "DeviceEvents (DNS)"
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    DnsEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where SubType == "LookupQuery"
    | where IPAddresses has Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Domain = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", Name)), Url = "", Client = ClientIP, Source = "DnsEvents"
),
(
    ASimDnsActivityLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DnsResponseName has Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Domain = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", DnsQuery)), Url = "", Client = tolower(coalesce(SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr)),
        Source = strcat("ASimDnsActivityLogs (", EventProduct, ")")
),
(
    _Sysmon(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([22]), Value)
    | where QueryResults has Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Domain = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", QueryName)), Url = "", Client = tolower(Computer), Source = "Sysmon 22"
),
(
    ASimWebSessionLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DstIpAddr == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, Domain = coalesce(_Host(Url), tolower(HttpHost), tolower(DstHostname)), Url,
        Client = tolower(coalesce(SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr)), Source = strcat("ASimWebSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")")
),
(
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DestinationIP == Value
    | where isnotempty(RequestURL) or isnotempty(DestinationHostName)
    | project TimeGenerated, Domain = coalesce(_Host(RequestURL), tolower(DestinationHostName)), Url = RequestURL,
        Client = tolower(coalesce(SourceHostName, SourceIP)), Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")")
)
// @sentinel-only:end
| where isnotempty(Domain) and Domain != Value
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count(),
    Urls = make_set_if(Url, isnotempty(Url), 10), ClientCount = dcount(Client), Clients = make_set(Client, 10),
    Sources = make_set(Source) by Domain
| sort by ClientCount asc, FirstSeen asc
| project Domain, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Events, ClientCount, Clients, Urls, Sources

rules.name: Emails sent from the IP
rules.description: Messages received by Defender for Office 365 whose sending server has this IP (EmailEvents, SenderIPv4 or SenderIPv6), one row per sender: envelope and header addresses, domains, recipients, subjects, detected threats and delivery actions. Used to go from a sending server IP (headers, phishing alert) to the senders and recipients to pivot on next (EM-P1, EM-P5).

reading.decisive: Several different senders or header domains from the same IP, with detected threats or a first contact (IsFirstContact).
reading.context: Envelope address (SenderMailFromAddress) different from the header address (SenderFromAddress); messages delivered despite a detection.
reading.noise: IPs of shared mail gateways (Exchange Online, bulk email providers, newsletters).

rules.name: Files downloaded from the IP
rules.description: Files whose download origin is this IP, one row per file (hash): origin IP recorded by Defender for Endpoint when the file was written (DeviceFileEvents, FileOriginIP), with the URL and referrer, the devices, the accounts and the process that wrote it. In Sentinel, downloads seen by the proxy (ASimWebSessionLogs, hash of the transferred file) and by CEF appliances (CommonSecurityLog, FileHash) fill the gap when the workstation is not covered. Gives the hashes to pivot on next (HS-P1, HS-P2).

reading.decisive: Executable, script or archive downloaded from a public IP without a domain name, written by a browser, Outlook or an interpreter (powershell.exe, mshta.exe).
reading.context: Same file downloaded on several devices within a short interval; origin URL on a non-standard port.
reading.noise: Internal update and software distribution servers (WSUS, SCCM) or vendor CDNs.

rules.query:
// [IP-P9] Files downloaded from the IP — Pivot / IP address
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 10080) * 1m; // default: 7d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 1d
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where FileOriginIP == Value
    | project TimeGenerated, SHA256 = tolower(SHA256), SHA1 = tolower(SHA1), FileName, FolderPath, Machine = tolower(DeviceName),
        Account = tolower(coalesce(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, InitiatingProcessAccountName)), OriginUrl = FileOriginUrl,
        Referrer = FileOriginReferrerUrl, Via = InitiatingProcessFileName, Source = "DeviceFileEvents"
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    ASimWebSessionLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DstIpAddr == Value
    | where isnotempty(FileSHA256) or isnotempty(FileSHA1) or isnotempty(FileMD5)
    | project TimeGenerated, SHA256 = tolower(coalesce(FileSHA256, FileMD5)), SHA1 = tolower(FileSHA1), FileName, FolderPath = "",
        Machine = tolower(coalesce(SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr)), Account = tolower(SrcUsername), OriginUrl = Url, Referrer = HttpReferrer,
        Via = strcat("Proxy · ", HttpUserAgent), Source = strcat("ASimWebSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")")
),
(
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DestinationIP == Value and isnotempty(FileHash)
    | project TimeGenerated, SHA256 = tolower(FileHash), SHA1 = "", FileName, FolderPath = FilePath,
        Machine = tolower(coalesce(SourceHostName, SourceIP)), Account = tolower(SourceUserName), OriginUrl = RequestURL, Referrer = "",
        Via = DeviceProduct, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")")
)
// @sentinel-only:end
| where isnotempty(SHA256) or isnotempty(SHA1)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count(), MachineCount = dcount(Machine),
    Machines = make_set(Machine, 10), Accounts = make_set_if(Account, isnotempty(Account), 10), FileNames = make_set(FileName, 5),
    Folders = make_set(FolderPath, 5), OriginUrls = make_set_if(OriginUrl, isnotempty(OriginUrl), 5),
    Referrers = make_set_if(Referrer, isnotempty(Referrer), 5), WrittenBy = make_set(Via, 5), Sources = make_set(Source)
    by FileHash = coalesce(SHA256, SHA1)
| extend Executable = tostring(FileNames) matches regex @"(?i)\.(exe|dll|scr|ps1|js|jse|vbs|vbe|hta|bat|cmd|msi|lnk|iso|img|zip|7z|rar)\b"
| sort by Executable desc, FirstSeen asc
| project FileHash, FileNames, Executable, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Events, MachineCount, Machines, Accounts, OriginUrls,
    Referrers, WrittenBy, Folders, Sources

rules.name: Windows authentication chain from the IP
rules.description: Sequence of Windows authentication events linked to the IP: 4625 (failure), 4624 (success), 4648 (explicit credentials), 4768 and 4769 (Kerberos), 4771, 4776 (NTLM), then, for each opened session, the 4672 (privileges), 4688 (processes started in the session) and 4634 or 4647 (logoff) events, linked by the logon ID on the same device. Covers SecurityEvent and WindowsEvent, including when the columns are only filled in the raw XML. LoggedOn is the device that logged the event, Target the device actually targeted (requested service for a 4769, target server for a 4648) and ValidatedBy the domain controller that validated the credentials; the known role of LoggedOn is shown (LoggedOnRole).

reading.decisive: Series of 4625 then 4624 of type 3 or 10, followed by a 4672 and 4688 events in the same session.
reading.context: 4769 ticket requested with RC4 encryption (0x17) for a service account (Kerberoasting).
reading.noise: Repeated type 3 logons by file, print or monitoring servers.

rules.query:
// [IP-T1] Windows authentication chain from the IP — Timeline / IP address
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}

let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 30) * 1m; // default: 30m
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 30) * 1m; // default: 30m
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;

        id == 4625, "Failed logon",
        id == 4634, "Logoff",
        id == 4647, "User-initiated logoff",
        id == 4648, "Logon with explicit credentials",
        id == 4656, "Handle to an object requested",
        id == 4657, "Registry value modified",
        id == 4658, "Handle closed",
        id == 4660, "Object deleted",
        id == 4663, "Object access",
        id == 4670, "Object permissions changed",

        id == 4697, "Service installed",

        id == 4702, "Scheduled task updated",

// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term

            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            ServiceFileName = coalesce(ServiceFileName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(ShareName, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            AccessMask = coalesce(AccessMask, extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessList = extract(@'<Data Name="AccessList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),

            PrivilegeList = coalesce(PrivilegeList, extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "SecurityEvent"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskContent = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskContent), tostring(EventData.TaskContentNew), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberName), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceFileName), tostring(EventData.ImagePath), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareName), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.RelativeTargetName), extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessMask), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessList), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectType), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            HandleId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.HandleId), extract(@'<Data Name="HandleId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectValueName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectValueName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectValueName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareLocalPath = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareLocalPath), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareLocalPath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | extend _svcAccount = tolower(tostring(split(ServiceName, "@")[0]))
    | extend TargetHost = tolower(case(
            EventID == 4769 and _svcAccount endswith "$", trim_end(@"\$", _svcAccount),
            EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), "",
            EventID == 4648 and isnotempty(TargetServerName) and TargetServerName !in~ ("-", "localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"), TargetServerName,
            Computer)),
        AuthAuthority = iff(EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), tolower(Computer), ""),
