// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

rules.name: Discovery: where the value appears
rules.description: Looks for the value in every table (union * | where * has) and returns one row per table and location: column, or path in a JSON (for example RawEventData['1']['parameters']['ip']), likely role (source or destination), value alone or inside a text, and table statistics (volume, first and last seen, active hours, top devices, accounts and actions). Status compares each location with the columns the rules of the indicator read: "Not read by the rules" points to a source to add to the catalog. Expensive: keep a short window.

reading.decisive: A "Not read by the rules" location with exact rows: the value is there and no pivot looks at it.
reading.context: Tables where the value appears with many devices or accounts (shared IP, service account), or only in free text.
reading.noise: Matches in text fields (messages, command lines, URLs) that mention the value without carrying it.

// 1. A single pass over every table
let Hits = materialize(
    union isfuzzy=true withsource=Table *
    | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where * has Term
    | extend Row = pack_all(true));
// 2. Per-table statistics, over every row found
let PerTable = Hits
    | extend Host = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.DeviceName), tostring(Row.Computer), tostring(Row.HostName), tostring(Row.DvcHostname),
          tostring(Row.SrcHostname), tostring(Row.SourceHostName))),
        Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.AccountName), tostring(Row.UserPrincipalName), tostring(Row.TargetUserName),
          tostring(Row.SubjectUserName), tostring(Row.InitiatingProcessAccountName), tostring(Row.AccountUpn), tostring(Row.UserId),
          tostring(Row.Caller), tostring(Row.SrcUsername))),
        Action = coalesce(tostring(Row.ActionType), tostring(Row.EventID), tostring(Row.Operation), tostring(Row.OperationName),
          tostring(Row.ResultType), tostring(Row.DeviceAction))
    | summarize TableEvents = count(), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
        ActiveHours = dcount(bin(Timestamp, 1h)), Hosts = dcountif(Host, isnotempty(Host)), Accounts = dcountif(Account, isnotempty(Account)),
        TopHosts = make_set_if(Host, isnotempty(Host), 5), TopAccounts = make_set_if(Account, isnotempty(Account), 5),
        TopActions = make_set_if(Action, isnotempty(Action), 5)
        by Table;
// 3. Exact locations: column, or path in a JSON (5 levels), on a sample per table
let Locations = Hits
    | sort by Table asc
    | where row_number(1, prev(Table) != Table) <= SamplePerTable
    | mv-apply Cell = Row on (
        extend Column = tostring(bag_keys(Cell)[0])
        | extend Raw = Cell[Column]
        | where tostring(Raw) has Term
        | project Column, Raw)
    | project Table, Column, Path = Column, Text = substring(tostring(Raw), 0, 3000),
        V = iff(gettype(Raw) in ("dictionary", "array"), Raw, parse_json(tostring(Raw)))
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend Exact = tolower(tostring(V)) == tolower(Term) or tostring(V) == Value
    | extend Role = case(Path matches regex @"(?i)(src|source|client|caller|remote|initiat|sender|origin)", "source",
        Path matches regex @"(?i)(dst|dest|target|local|recipient|server)", "destination",
        "undetermined")
    | summarize LocationRows = count(), ExactRows = countif(Exact), Example = take_any(Text) by Table, Column, Path, Role;
Locations
| join kind=leftouter (Known) on Table, Column
| join kind=inner (PerTable) on Table
| extend Status = case(isempty(Rules), "Not read by the rules", Path == Column, "Read by the rules", "Column read, JSON path to check")
| extend Order = case(Status startswith "Not read", 0, Status startswith "Column", 1, 2)
| sort by Order asc, TableEvents desc
| project Table, Path, Role, Status, Rules, LocationRows, ExactRows, TableEvents, FirstSeen, LastSeen, ActiveHours,
    Hosts, Accounts, TopHosts, TopAccounts, TopActions, Example

rules.name: IPs and devices used by the account
rules.description: IP, country, provider (ASN), device, OS and browser of the account's Entra ID sign-ins, compared with the 30 days before the window: each row shows whether the IP, country, ASN or device is new. Completed by Active Directory authentications seen by Defender for Identity (IdentityLogonEvents, excluding Entra ID: IP and name of the source workstation, country and provider, protocol) and by Defender for Cloud Apps cloud activity (CloudAppEvents: IP, country, city, provider, device type, OS and user agent; linked to the account by its object ID or its UPN). For these two sources, the device is compared by name (no Entra ID device ID) and SignIns counts authentications or actions. ISPs and Sources are added.

reading.decisive: Successful sign-in from an IP, ASN and device that are all new, shortly after a click or a spray; cloud activity from an IP missing from Entra ID sign-ins (replayed token).
reading.context: Unmanaged or non-compliant device, command-line tool or script user agent; Active Directory authentication from a workstation never seen for this account.
reading.noise: New residential IP (remote work), mobile tethering, new workstation; IP of a proxy or a Microsoft service in CloudAppEvents.

rules.name: Devices where the account logged on
rules.description: Devices linked to the account, sorted by kind of link (Perspective column) so that the device actually used is not mistaken for the domain controller that validated the credentials: 1. "Session on the device": logon on the device itself (Defender for Endpoint, 4624 and 4625 from the device, Defender for Identity, ASIM, SSH); 2. "Explicit credentials to the device": 4648 (runas, logon with other credentials), the device is the target server; 3. "Kerberos service ticket": 4769 logged by the DC for a service of the device (share, RDP, WinRM…), the only trace when the device itself does not send its logs; 4. "Source workstation (seen by the DC)": workstation or IP the account authenticated from (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776, Defender for Identity); 5. "Network access to the domain controller": network logon (type 3) on a DC (group policies, SYSVOL, LDAP), present for every domain account, ranked last. The role of each device (detected DC, EasyPivotRoles watchlist) is shown, and ValidatedBy lists the DCs that validated the credentials.

reading.decisive: Standard account with a session on sensitive servers or domain controllers (type 2 or 10) outside its scope.
reading.context: Unusual RemoteInteractive (RDP) or NewCredentials (runas /netonly) logons; 4769 tickets to a server never seen before.
reading.noise: Network access to DCs (GPO, SYSVOL), shared workstations, file or print servers with network logons (type 3).

rules.query:
// [AC-P2] Devices where the account logged on — Pivot / Account
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 24h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // default: 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Account indicator: accepts a UPN (user@domain), DOMAIN\user or a SAM name.
// ValueUpn is used for Entra ID and Microsoft 365 logs, ValueSam for Windows and Defender logs.
let ValueUpn = tolower(Value);
let ValueSam = tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(ValueUpn, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1]));
let _WinEventName = (id:int) {

// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent

// Entity roles (devices, IPs, accounts): separates "where the event is logged" from "where the entity is used"
// and flags entities that skew a pivot (domain controller, NAT, proxy, service account...).
// Three combined sources:
// 1. automatic domain controller (DC) detection: hosts emitting 4768 (only a KDC does), LDAP targets seen by
//    Defender for Identity, devices accepting Kerberos connections (port 88) according to Defender for Endpoint;
// 2. Sentinel watchlist "EasyPivotRoles" (columns Entity, Type, Role, Note), template in watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv;
//    Type values (case-insensitive): Machine/Host/Device, IP/CIDR/Subnet, Account/User (French values still accepted);
// 3. accounts: IdentityInfo (Entra ID roles, privileged AD groups, service account, Defender for Identity tags)
//    and reserved names (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync).
// Each function takes the reference time `at` and looks at the preceding day (14 days for IdentityInfo).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks are removed from the Defender XDR variant (tables missing in Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h): lowercase short name (FQDN, NetBIOS, machine account "PC01$" -> "pc01"); empty for an IP address.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a): SAM name of an account, from "DOMAIN\name", "name@domain" or "name".
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(name, role): "dc01 [DC]", to annotate lists (make_set) without adding a column.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b): joins two role labels, skipping empty ones.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(SAM name): category inferred from the name alone.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Machine account",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "System account",
        sam == "krbtgt", "KDC account (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Entra Connect sync",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Built-in administrator",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at): devices (and IPs) that behave like domain controllers.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "LDAP target (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepts Kerberos on port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at): MachineKey (short name), MachineRole ("DC, File server"), MachineRoleBasis (evidence).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at): Ip (exact address or CIDR range), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at): known roles of an address, including membership in a watchlist CIDR range.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at): AccountKey (lowercase SAM name or UPN), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Entra ID role assigned"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Privileged AD group", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Service account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Sensitive account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Honeytoken account", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};

        Success = EventID != 4625, SourceIp = IpAddress, SourceHost = iff(EventID == 4648, tolower(Computer), tolower(WorkstationName)),
        AuthBy = "", IsLocalAdmin = bool(null)
),
(
    Win
    | where EventID == 4769 and isnotempty(TargetHost)
    | project TimeGenerated, Machine = TargetHost, Perspective = "Kerberos service ticket (seen by the DC)", Source = SourceTable,
        LogonType = strcat("Kerberos · ", ServiceName), Success = Status in ("", "-", "0x0"), SourceIp = IpAddress, SourceHost = "",
        AuthBy = AuthAuthority, IsLocalAdmin = bool(null)
),
(
    Win
    | where EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776) and isnotempty(SourceHost)
    | project TimeGenerated, Machine = SourceHost, Perspective = "Source workstation (seen by the DC)", Source = SourceTable,
        LogonType = strcat(tostring(EventID), " ", EventName), Success = EventID != 4771 and Status in ("", "-", "0x0"),
        SourceIp = IpAddress, SourceHost = "", AuthBy = AuthAuthority, IsLocalAdmin = bool(null)
),
// @sentinel-only:end
(
    IdentityLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where AccountUpn =~ ValueUpn or AccountName =~ ValueSam
    | extend Pair = pack_array(
        bag_pack("Machine", tolower(TargetDeviceName), "Perspective", "Session on the device"),
        bag_pack("Machine", tolower(DeviceName), "Perspective", "Source workstation (seen by the DC)"))
    | mv-expand Pair
    | project TimeGenerated, Machine = tostring(Pair.Machine), Perspective = tostring(Pair.Perspective), Source = "IdentityLogonEvents",
        LogonType = strcat(Protocol, " ", LogonType), Success = ActionType == "LogonSuccess", SourceIp = IPAddress,

)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    ASimAuthenticationEventLogs

    | where TargetUsername has ValueSam

    | project TimeGenerated, Machine = tolower(coalesce(TargetHostname, DvcHostname)), Perspective = "Session on the device",
        Source = strcat("ASIM ", EventProduct), LogonType = strcat(LogonProtocol, " ", LogonMethod), Success = EventResult == "Success",
        SourceIp = SrcIpAddr, SourceHost = tolower(SrcHostname), AuthBy = "", IsLocalAdmin = bool(null)
),
(
    Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where ProcessName in~ ("sshd", "sshd-session") and SyslogMessage has ValueSam
    | extend User = extract(@"(?:Accepted|Failed) \S+ for (?:invalid user )?(\S+) from", 1, SyslogMessage)
    | where tolower(User) == ValueSam
    | project TimeGenerated, Machine = tolower(Computer), Perspective = "Session on the device", Source = "Syslog (sshd)",

    SourceHosts = make_set_if(SourceHost, isnotempty(SourceHost), 10), ValidatedBy = make_set_if(AuthBy, isnotempty(AuthBy), 5),

rules.name: Admin and file actions of the account
rules.description: Operations performed by the account, or targeting it: Entra ID audit (AuditLogs), Microsoft 365 (OfficeActivity and CloudAppEvents, which overlap depending on the enabled connectors), Azure Resource Manager, and Microsoft Graph and legacy Azure AD Graph calls (MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs, AADGraphActivityLogs, linked to the account by its object ID found in its sign-ins), and on-premises Active Directory seen by Defender for Identity (IdentityDirectoryEvents: group, password, attribute and delegation changes made by the account or targeting it; the actor is read from ACTOR.ACCOUNT, the target from TargetAccountUpn or the group involved).

reading.decisive: MFA method added, role assigned, bulk read of files or secrets right after a suspicious sign-in; account added to a privileged Active Directory group or password reset made by the account.
reading.context: Operations on resources outside the account's usual scope.
reading.noise: OneDrive sync, scheduled admin operations, automation accounts.

rules.query:
// [AC-P3] Admin and file actions of the account — Pivot / Account
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 240) * 1m; // default: 4h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 240) * 1m; // default: 4h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Account indicator: accepts a UPN (user@domain), DOMAIN\user or a SAM name.
// ValueUpn is used for Entra ID and Microsoft 365 logs, ValueSam for Windows and Defender logs.
let ValueUpn = tolower(Value);
let ValueSam = tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(ValueUpn, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1]));
// Entra ID user sign-ins, normalized whatever table holds them:
// - Sentinel: SigninLogs (interactive) and AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs (non-interactive). In the latter,
//   DeviceDetail, Status and LocationDetails are JSON strings: they are parsed to produce the same columns.
// - Defender XDR: EntraIdSignInEvents (interactive and non-interactive, Timestamp column, ErrorCode 0 = success).
//   It is read only for the sign-in type the Sentinel table does not provide over the period: no duplicates
//   in the unified portal, and sign-ins stay visible without the Sentinel Entra ID connector.
// "@sentinel-only" blocks (Sentinel tables) are removed from the Defender XDR variant, which then reads only EntraIdSignInEvents.
// Parameters: start, end, ip (empty = all), upn (empty = all). Result: 0 = success. SourceTable gives the source table.
let _Signins = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ip:string, upn:string) {
    let _HasInteractive = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        // @sentinel-only:begin
        (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        // @sentinel-only:end
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    let _HasNonInteractive = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        // @sentinel-only:begin
        (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated between ((start - 1d) .. end) | take 1 | project Present = 1),
        // @sentinel-only:end
        (print Present = 0)
        | summarize max(Present)) == 1;
    union isfuzzy=true
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SigninLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = DeviceDetail, _loc = LocationDetails, _st = Status
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "SigninLogs", SignInType = "Interactive", UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId,
            ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason), IPAddress, Location,
            City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName),
            DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem), Browser = tostring(_dev.browser),
            IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant), TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType),
            ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    (
        AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _loc = parse_json(LocationDetails), _st = parse_json(Status)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", SignInType = "NonInteractive", UserPrincipalName, UserId,
            AppDisplayName, AppId, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
            IPAddress, Location, City = tostring(_loc.city), AutonomousSystemNumber, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent,
            DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName), DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
            Browser = tostring(_dev.browser), IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
            TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType), ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SessionId, CorrelationId
    ),
    // ADFSSignInLogs: AD FS sign-ins reported by Microsoft Entra Connect Health (SignInType "AD FS"), as a complement.
    // They cover federated applications specific to AD FS; a federated sign-in to an Entra ID application also appears in SigninLogs.
    (
        ADFSSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or UserPrincipalName =~ upn
        | extend _dev = parse_json(DeviceDetail), _st = parse_json(Status)
        | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable = "ADFSSignInLogs", SignInType = "AD FS", UserPrincipalName, UserId, AppDisplayName, AppId,
            ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription = tostring(_st.additionalDetails), FailureReason = tostring(_st.failureReason),
            IPAddress, Location = "", City = "", AutonomousSystemNumber = "", ClientAppUsed = "", UserAgent,
            DeviceName = tostring(_dev.displayName), DeviceId = tostring(_dev.deviceId), OperatingSystem = tostring(_dev.operatingSystem),
            Browser = tostring(_dev.browser), IsManaged = tostring(_dev.isManaged), IsCompliant = tostring(_dev.isCompliant),
            TrustType = tostring(_dev.trustType), ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement = "", RiskLevelDuringSignIn = "",
            SessionId = "", CorrelationId
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        EntraIdSignInEvents
        | where Timestamp between (start .. end)
        | extend SignInType = iff(LogonType contains "noninteractive", "NonInteractive", "Interactive")
        | where (SignInType == "Interactive" and not(_HasInteractive)) or (SignInType == "NonInteractive" and not(_HasNonInteractive))
        | where isempty(ip) or IPAddress == ip
        | where isempty(upn) or AccountUpn =~ upn
        | project TimeGenerated = Timestamp, SourceTable = "EntraIdSignInEvents", SignInType, UserPrincipalName = AccountUpn,
            UserId = AccountObjectId, AppDisplayName = Application, AppId = ApplicationId, ResourceDisplayName,
            ResultType = tostring(ErrorCode), ResultDescription = "", FailureReason = "", IPAddress, Location = Country, City,
            AutonomousSystemNumber = "", ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, DeviceName, DeviceId = EntraIdDeviceId, OperatingSystem = OSPlatform,
            Browser, IsManaged = tostring(IsManaged == 1), IsCompliant = tostring(IsCompliant == 1), TrustType = DeviceTrustType,
            ConditionalAccessStatus = case(ConditionalAccessStatus == 0, "success", ConditionalAccessStatus == 1, "failure",
                ConditionalAccessStatus == 2, "notApplied", tostring(ConditionalAccessStatus)),
            AuthenticationRequirement,
            RiskLevelDuringSignIn = case(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 100, "high", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 50, "medium",
                RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 10, "low", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 0, "none", tostring(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)),
            SessionId, CorrelationId
    )
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0"
};
let UserIds = _Signins(StartTimestamp - 1d, EndTimestamp, "", ValueUpn) | where isnotempty(UserId) | distinct UserId;
union isfuzzy=true
// @sentinel-only:begin
(
    MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where UserId in (UserIds)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs", Operation = strcat(RequestMethod, " ",
            replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}", "{id}")),
        Role = "Actor", Target = AppId, Result = tostring(ResponseStatusCode), IP = IPAddress
),
(
    AADGraphActivityLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where UserId in (UserIds)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AADGraphActivityLogs", Operation = strcat(RequestMethod, " ",
            replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @"[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}", "{id}")),
        Role = "Actor", Target = AppId, Result = tostring(ResponseStatusCode), IP = CallerIpAddress
),
(
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where InitiatedBy has ValueUpn or TargetResources has ValueUpn
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AuditLogs (Entra ID)", Operation = OperationName,
        Role = iff(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName) =~ ValueUpn, "Actor", "Target"),
        Target = coalesce(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName), tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)),
        Result, IP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
),
(
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where UserId =~ ValueUpn
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("OfficeActivity (", OfficeWorkload, ")"), Operation, Role = "Actor",
        Target = coalesce(OfficeObjectId, SourceFileName), Result = ResultStatus, IP = ClientIP
),
// @sentinel-only:end
(
    CloudAppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where tostring(RawEventData.UserId) =~ ValueUpn
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CloudAppEvents (", Application, ")"), Operation = ActionType, Role = "Actor",
        Target = ObjectName, Result = "", IP = IPAddress
),
(
    // On-premises Active Directory (Defender for Identity): account, group and attribute changes made by the
    // account or targeting it; the actor is in AdditionalFields["ACTOR.ACCOUNT"]
    IdentityDirectoryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | extend Actor = tolower(tostring(AdditionalFields["ACTOR.ACCOUNT"]))
    | where AccountUpn =~ ValueUpn or AccountName =~ ValueSam or TargetAccountUpn =~ ValueUpn or Actor == ValueSam or Actor == ValueUpn
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("IdentityDirectoryEvents (", Application, ")"), Operation = ActionType,
        Role = iff(Actor in (ValueSam, ValueUpn), "Actor", "Target"),
        Target = coalesce(TargetAccountUpn, TargetAccountDisplayName, TargetDeviceName, tostring(AdditionalFields["TO.GROUP"]),
            tostring(AdditionalFields["FROM.GROUP"]), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        Result = "", IP = IPAddress
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    AzureActivity
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where Caller =~ ValueUpn
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AzureActivity", Operation = OperationNameValue, Role = "Actor",
        Target = _ResourceId, Result = ActivityStatusValue, IP = CallerIpAddress
)
// @sentinel-only:end
| summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Targets = make_set(Target, 10), IPs = make_set(IP, 5), Results = make_set(Result, 5) by Source, Operation, Role
| sort by Events desc

rules.name: Mailbox rules, consents and MFA methods
rules.description: Persistence changes on a cloud account: mailbox rules and forwarding (New-InboxRule, Set-Mailbox, UpdateInboxRules…), mailbox delegations, OAuth consents and granted permissions, added authentication methods, password and role changes.

reading.decisive: Forwarding or redirect rule to an external address, or consent to an unknown application, shortly after a suspicious sign-in.
reading.context: Rule that moves or deletes messages containing "invoice", "payment" or the name of the help desk.
reading.noise: Out-of-office replies, shared mailboxes, MFA registration after a phone change.

rules.name: Account profile and roles
rules.description: Tells who the account is before pivoting on it: IdentityInfo record (name, department, job title, state, type), known roles (Entra ID role assigned, privileged AD group, service account, sensitive or honeytoken account according to Defender for Identity, EasyPivotRoles watchlist), category inferred from the name (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync, built-in administrator) and behavior over the window: service or batch logons, number of devices and IPs, share of non-interactive sign-ins. An account that behaves like a service account without being declared as one is flagged.

reading.decisive: Privileged or sensitive account involved in the alert, or service account used in an interactive session.
reading.context: Disabled or deleted account that still authenticates; account with no IdentityInfo record (local, external, recent).
reading.noise: Service and sync accounts, very frequent in all authentication logs.

// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"

// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names

let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term

        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            ShareName = coalesce(ShareName, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

        | extend SourceTable = "SecurityEvent"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AuthenticationPackageName), tostring(EventData.PackageName), extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.WorkstationName), tostring(EventData.Workstation), extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpPort), tostring(EventData.ClientPort), extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskContent = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskContent), tostring(EventData.TaskContentNew), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberName), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceFileName), tostring(EventData.ImagePath), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareName), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.RelativeTargetName), extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessMask), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessList), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectType), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            HandleId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.HandleId), extract(@'<Data Name="HandleId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectValueName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectValueName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectValueName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareLocalPath = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareLocalPath), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareLocalPath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | extend _svcAccount = tolower(tostring(split(ServiceName, "@")[0]))
    | extend TargetHost = tolower(case(
            EventID == 4769 and _svcAccount endswith "$", trim_end(@"\$", _svcAccount),
            EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), "",
            EventID == 4648 and isnotempty(TargetServerName) and TargetServerName !in~ ("-", "localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"), TargetServerName,
            Computer)),
        AuthAuthority = iff(EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), tolower(Computer), ""),
        SourceHost = tolower(coalesce(WorkstationName, IpAddress))

    | extend ObjectAccess = iff(EventID in (4656, 4658, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140, 5145, 4657), strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4416", "%%4419", "%%4423", "ReadData") or EventID == 5140, "read", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4417", "%%4418", "%%4420", "%%4424", "WriteData", "AppendData") or EventID == 4657, "write", ""),

            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%1539", "%%1540", "WRITE_DAC", "WRITE_OWNER") or EventID == 4670, "permissions", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4421", "Execute"), "execute", "")), dynamic([""])), ", "), "")
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, TargetHost, AuthAuthority, SourceHost, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, AccessList, ObjectType, HandleId, ObjectValueName, ShareLocalPath, ObjectAccess, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
// @sentinel-only:end
// Entity roles (devices, IPs, accounts): separates "where the event is logged" from "where the entity is used"
// and flags entities that skew a pivot (domain controller, NAT, proxy, service account...).
// Three combined sources:
// 1. automatic domain controller (DC) detection: hosts emitting 4768 (only a KDC does), LDAP targets seen by
//    Defender for Identity, devices accepting Kerberos connections (port 88) according to Defender for Endpoint;
// 2. Sentinel watchlist "EasyPivotRoles" (columns Entity, Type, Role, Note), template in watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv;
//    Type values (case-insensitive): Machine/Host/Device, IP/CIDR/Subnet, Account/User (French values still accepted);
// 3. accounts: IdentityInfo (Entra ID roles, privileged AD groups, service account, Defender for Identity tags)
//    and reserved names (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync).
// Each function takes the reference time `at` and looks at the preceding day (14 days for IdentityInfo).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks are removed from the Defender XDR variant (tables missing in Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h): lowercase short name (FQDN, NetBIOS, machine account "PC01$" -> "pc01"); empty for an IP address.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a): SAM name of an account, from "DOMAIN\name", "name@domain" or "name".
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(name, role): "dc01 [DC]", to annotate lists (make_set) without adding a column.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b): joins two role labels, skipping empty ones.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(SAM name): category inferred from the name alone.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Machine account",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "System account",
        sam == "krbtgt", "KDC account (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Entra Connect sync",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Built-in administrator",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at): devices (and IPs) that behave like domain controllers.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "LDAP target (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepts Kerberos on port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at): MachineKey (short name), MachineRole ("DC, File server"), MachineRoleBasis (evidence).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at): Ip (exact address or CIDR range), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at): known roles of an address, including membership in a watchlist CIDR range.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at): AccountKey (lowercase SAM name or UPN), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Entra ID role assigned"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Privileged AD group", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Service account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Sensitive account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Honeytoken account", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};
let Profile = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(Sam:string)[] | extend Upn = "", DisplayName = "", Department = "", JobTitle = "", Enabled = "", UserType = "", Risk = "",
        LastSeenInDirectory = datetime(null)),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((T0 - 14d) .. EndTimestamp)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", ""))))
        | where Sam == ValueSam or Upn == ValueUpn
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Sam
        | project Sam, Upn, DisplayName = AccountDisplayName, Department = tostring(column_ifexists("Department", "")),
            JobTitle = tostring(column_ifexists("JobTitle", "")), Enabled = tostring(column_ifexists("IsAccountEnabled", "")),
            UserType = tostring(column_ifexists("UserType", "")), Risk = tostring(column_ifexists("RiskLevel", "")),
            LastSeenInDirectory = TimeGenerated
    )
    | take 1;
let Roles = _AccountRoles(EndTimestamp) | where AccountKey in (ValueSam, ValueUpn)
    | summarize KnownRoles = strcat_array(make_set(AccountRole), ", "), RoleBasis = make_set(AccountRoleBasis, 10);
let Logons = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(Machine:string, LogonType:string, Source:string)[]),
    (DeviceLogonEvents | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | where AccountName =~ ValueSam
        | project Machine = tolower(DeviceName), LogonType, Source = "DeviceLogonEvents")
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    , (_WinSecurity(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([4624]), ValueSam) | where TargetSam == ValueSam
        | project Machine = TargetHost, LogonType = LogonTypeName, Source = SourceTable)
    // @sentinel-only:end
    | summarize Machines = dcount(Machine), ServiceLogons = countif(LogonType in ("Service", "Batch")),
        InteractiveLogons = countif(LogonType in ("Interactive", "RemoteInteractive", "CachedInteractive", "Unlock")), Logons = count();
let Cloud = _Signins(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, "", ValueUpn)
    | summarize SignIns = count(), NonInteractive = countif(SignInType == "NonInteractive"), CloudIPs = dcount(IPAddress);
print Account = Value, Sam = ValueSam
| extend NameCategory = _AccountKind(ValueSam)
| extend KnownRoles = toscalar(Roles | project KnownRoles), RoleBasis = toscalar(Roles | project RoleBasis)
| extend P = toscalar(Profile | project pack_all())
| extend L = toscalar(Logons | project pack_all()), C = toscalar(Cloud | project pack_all())
| extend BehavesLikeService = toint(L.ServiceLogons) > 0 and toint(L.InteractiveLogons) == 0
| extend Assessment = case(
    isnotempty(KnownRoles), strcat("Known role: ", KnownRoles),
    isnotempty(NameCategory), strcat("Category: ", NameCategory),
    BehavesLikeService, "Behaves like a service account (service or batch logons, no interactive logon) without being declared as one",
    isempty(tostring(P.Sam)), "Missing from IdentityInfo: local, external or recent account, or UEBA not enabled",
    "User account with no known special role")
| project Account, Sam, Assessment, KnownRoles, NameCategory, DisplayName = tostring(P.DisplayName), Upn = tostring(P.Upn),
    Department = tostring(P.Department), JobTitle = tostring(P.JobTitle), Enabled = tostring(P.Enabled), UserType = tostring(P.UserType),
    Risk = tostring(P.Risk), Machines = toint(L.Machines), Logons = toint(L.Logons), ServiceLogons = toint(L.ServiceLogons),
    InteractiveLogons = toint(L.InteractiveLogons), SignIns = toint(C.SignIns), NonInteractiveSignIns = toint(C.NonInteractive),
    CloudIPs = toint(C.CloudIPs), RoleBasis

rules.name: Files and shares accessed by the account
rules.description: Files and shares read, written, deleted or whose permissions changed, by the account, grouped by device, folder and access kind: Windows object access audit (4656, 4663, 4670, and 4660 linked to the file by its handle) on devices where a SACL is set, network share access (5140, 5145) logged by file servers, files created, modified or deleted seen by Defender for Endpoint and by Sysmon (11, 15, 23, 26), ASIM file logs, and SharePoint or OneDrive files (OfficeActivity). Reads are only visible in the Windows and SharePoint audit: Defender for Endpoint and Sysmon do not log reads.

reading.decisive: Bulk read or download on a share or in SharePoint shortly before an outbound connection or an archive (exfiltration).
reading.context: Access to administrative shares (C$, ADMIN$) or to sensitive folders outside the account's scope; permissions changed.
reading.noise: Roaming profiles, folder redirection, OneDrive sync, antivirus and backup.

rules.query:
// [AC-P6] Files and shares accessed by the account — Pivot / Account
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 24h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // default: 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Account indicator: accepts a UPN (user@domain), DOMAIN\user or a SAM name.
// ValueUpn is used for Entra ID and Microsoft 365 logs, ValueSam for Windows and Defender logs.
let ValueUpn = tolower(Value);
let ValueSam = tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(ValueUpn, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1]));
let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Successful logon",
        id == 4625, "Failed logon",
        id == 4634, "Logoff",
        id == 4647, "User-initiated logoff",
        id == 4648, "Logon with explicit credentials",
        id == 4656, "Handle to an object requested",
        id == 4657, "Registry value modified",
        id == 4658, "Handle closed",
        id == 4660, "Object deleted",
        id == 4663, "Object access",
        id == 4670, "Object permissions changed",
        id == 4672, "Special privileges assigned",
        id == 4688, "Process created",
        id == 4697, "Service installed",
        id == 4698, "Scheduled task created",
        id == 4702, "Scheduled task updated",
        id == 4720, "User account created",
        id == 4722, "User account enabled",
        id == 4724, "Password reset",
        id == 4728, "Member added to a security-enabled global group",
        id == 4732, "Member added to a security-enabled local group",
        id == 4740, "Account locked out",
        id == 4756, "Member added to a security-enabled universal group",
        id == 4768, "Kerberos TGT requested",
        id == 4769, "Kerberos service ticket requested",
        id == 4771, "Kerberos pre-authentication failed",

        id == 4778, "RDP session reconnected",
        id == 4779, "RDP session disconnected",
        id == 5140, "Network share accessed",
        id == 5145, "Network share object access check",

let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",

        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",

// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
