// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),

rules.name: Source coverage
rules.description: State of the 21 sources read by the "E-mail address" rules (21 tables). A source is a table, or part of a logged table: for example SecurityEvent · file access (4656, 4660, 4663, 4670). For each one: table present or not, fed in the window, events actually collected (audit policy, data collection rule), missing columns used by the rules, and whether another source of the same family compensates. Run it first on a new environment: a missing source raises no error, it only returns empty results.

reading.decisive: A "Not covered" row: no source of the family is fed, the listed rules cannot show anything of that kind of event.
reading.context: An "Events not collected" row: the table is fed but not with these EventIDs (audit off, no SACL, data collection rule too narrow). "Missing columns": the schema differs, the matching branch is skipped.
reading.noise: A missing source "Compensated by" another: an equivalent source provides the same events.

let Rows = materialize(Expected
    | join kind=leftouter (Volume) on Member
    | join kind=leftouter (TableVolume) on Table
    | join kind=leftouter (Present) on Table
    | extend Exists = isnotnull(TableEvents) or isnotnull(PresentColumns)
    | extend MissingColumns = iff(isnotnull(PresentColumns), set_difference(Columns, PresentColumns), dynamic([]))
    | extend Status = case(not(Exists), "Missing or inaccessible", isnull(TableEvents) or isnull(Events), "Missing columns",
        TableEvents == 0, "Empty in the window", Events == 0, "Events not collected",
        array_length(MissingColumns) > 0, "Missing columns", "Fed"));
let Fed = Rows
    | mv-expand Family = Families to typeof(string)
    | summarize FedMembers = make_set_if(Member, Status == "Fed") by Family;
Rows
| mv-expand Family = Families to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter (Fed) on Family
| extend FedMembers = iff(array_length(FedMembers) == 0, dynamic([""]), FedMembers)
| mv-expand Alt = FedMembers to typeof(string)
| summarize Families = make_set(Family), Alternatives = make_set_if(Alt, isnotempty(Alt) and Alt != Member),
    Uncovered = make_set_if(Family, isempty(Alt)), FamilyHints = make_set_if(tostring(Hints[Family]), isempty(Alt))
    by Member, Status, Optional, MemberHint, Events, LastEvent, Missing = strcat_array(MissingColumns, ", "), Rules = strcat_array(Rules, ", ")
| extend Impact = case(Status == "Fed", "",
    Optional, "Optional: role enrichment only",
    array_length(Uncovered) > 0, strcat("Not covered: ", strcat_array(Uncovered, ", "), ". Incomplete results for ", Rules),
    strcat("Compensated by ", strcat_array(Alternatives, ", ")))
| extend Order = case(Status == "Fed", 4, Optional, 3, array_length(Uncovered) > 0, 0, Status == "Missing columns", 1, 2)
| sort by Order asc, Member asc
| project Status, Source = Member, Events, LastEvent, Impact, MissingColumns = Missing, Families, Rules,
    Remediation = iff(Status == "Fed" or Optional, "", iff(isnotempty(MemberHint), MemberHint, strcat_array(FamilyHints, " ")))

rules.name: Daily message volume by verdict
rules.description: Number of emails received and sent by the address, per day, split by delivery action and detected threat type (EmailEvents).

reading.decisive: Spike of outbound messages from the address (compromised account spreading phishing internally or externally).
reading.context: Rise in messages quarantined or flagged as Phish sent to the address.
reading.noise: Newsletters and automatic notifications, end-of-month bursts.

rules.name: Sender prevalence
rules.description: History of the address and its domain as senders over 30 days: first and last message, volume, recipients, active days, subjects, sending IPs, SPF, DKIM and DMARC results, detected threats.

reading.decisive: First message from the domain in the window, sent to several recipients, with failed authentication.
reading.context: Recent domain whose name looks like that of a partner or vendor.
reading.noise: New newsletters, new SaaS providers, platform notifications.

rules.name: Discovery: where the value appears
rules.description: Looks for the value in every table (union * | where * has) and returns one row per table and location: column, or path in a JSON (for example RawEventData['1']['parameters']['ip']), likely role (source or destination), value alone or inside a text, and table statistics (volume, first and last seen, active hours, top devices, accounts and actions). Status compares each location with the columns the rules of the indicator read: "Not read by the rules" points to a source to add to the catalog. Expensive: keep a short window.

reading.decisive: A "Not read by the rules" location with exact rows: the value is there and no pivot looks at it.
reading.context: Tables where the value appears with many devices or accounts (shared IP, service account), or only in free text.
reading.noise: Matches in text fields (messages, command lines, URLs) that mention the value without carrying it.

    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))

    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),

    | where tostring(V) has Term

    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend Exact = tolower(tostring(V)) == tolower(Term) or tostring(V) == Value
    | extend Role = case(Path matches regex @"(?i)(src|source|client|caller|remote|initiat|sender|origin)", "source",
        Path matches regex @"(?i)(dst|dest|target|local|recipient|server)", "destination",
        "undetermined")
    | summarize LocationRows = count(), ExactRows = countif(Exact), Example = take_any(Text) by Table, Column, Path, Role;
Locations
| join kind=leftouter (Known) on Table, Column
| join kind=inner (PerTable) on Table
| extend Status = case(isempty(Rules), "Not read by the rules", Path == Column, "Read by the rules", "Column read, JSON path to check")
| extend Order = case(Status startswith "Not read", 0, Status startswith "Column", 1, 2)
| sort by Order asc, TableEvents desc
| project Table, Path, Role, Status, Rules, LocationRows, ExactRows, TableEvents, FirstSeen, LastSeen, ActiveHours,

// 1. A single pass over every table
let Hits = materialize(
    union isfuzzy=true withsource=Table *
    | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where * has Term
    | extend Row = pack_all(true));
// 2. Per-table statistics, over every row found
let PerTable = Hits
    | extend Host = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.DeviceName), tostring(Row.Computer), tostring(Row.HostName), tostring(Row.DvcHostname),
          tostring(Row.SrcHostname), tostring(Row.SourceHostName))),
        Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.AccountName), tostring(Row.UserPrincipalName), tostring(Row.TargetUserName),
          tostring(Row.SubjectUserName), tostring(Row.InitiatingProcessAccountName), tostring(Row.AccountUpn), tostring(Row.UserId),
          tostring(Row.Caller), tostring(Row.SrcUsername))),
        Action = coalesce(tostring(Row.ActionType), tostring(Row.EventID), tostring(Row.Operation), tostring(Row.OperationName),
          tostring(Row.ResultType), tostring(Row.DeviceAction))
    | summarize TableEvents = count(), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
        ActiveHours = dcount(bin(Timestamp, 1h)), Hosts = dcountif(Host, isnotempty(Host)), Accounts = dcountif(Account, isnotempty(Account)),
        TopHosts = make_set_if(Host, isnotempty(Host), 5), TopAccounts = make_set_if(Account, isnotempty(Account), 5),
        TopActions = make_set_if(Action, isnotempty(Action), 5)
        by Table;
// 3. Exact locations: column, or path in a JSON (5 levels), on a sample per table
let Locations = Hits
    | sort by Table asc
    | where row_number(1, prev(Table) != Table) <= SamplePerTable
    | mv-apply Cell = Row on (
        extend Column = tostring(bag_keys(Cell)[0])
        | extend Raw = Cell[Column]
        | where tostring(Raw) has Term
        | project Column, Raw)
    | project Table, Column, Path = Column, Text = substring(tostring(Raw), 0, 3000),
        V = iff(gettype(Raw) in ("dictionary", "array"), Raw, parse_json(tostring(Raw)))
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend Exact = tolower(tostring(V)) == tolower(Term) or tostring(V) == Value
    | extend Role = case(Path matches regex @"(?i)(src|source|client|caller|remote|initiat|sender|origin)", "source",
        Path matches regex @"(?i)(dst|dest|target|local|recipient|server)", "destination",
        "undetermined")
    | summarize LocationRows = count(), ExactRows = countif(Exact), Example = take_any(Text) by Table, Column, Path, Role;
Locations
| join kind=leftouter (Known) on Table, Column
| join kind=inner (PerTable) on Table
| extend Status = case(isempty(Rules), "Not read by the rules", Path == Column, "Read by the rules", "Column read, JSON path to check")
| extend Order = case(Status startswith "Not read", 0, Status startswith "Column", 1, 2)
| sort by Order asc, TableEvents desc
| project Table, Path, Role, Status, Rules, LocationRows, ExactRows, TableEvents, FirstSeen, LastSeen, ActiveHours,
    Hosts, Accounts, TopHosts, TopAccounts, TopActions, Example

rules.name: Messages involving the address
rules.description: Emails received or sent by the address around T0 (4 hours before and 1 hour after by default), with delivery, threats, URLs and attachments, and the number of recipients who received the same subject from the same sender (campaign evidence). Each message is completed by post-delivery actions (EmailPostDeliveryEvents: ZAP, admin purge, move, with the destination folder), URL domains (EmailUrlInfo) and attachments, with the number of malicious attachments (EmailAttachmentInfo). Teams messages sent by the address or mentioning it (MessageEvents) are added, and in Sentinel the Exchange audit operations on the mailbox messages (OfficeActivity: send, send as or on behalf of, delete, move; ClientIP is the IP of the mail client). The Source column gives the source table of each row.

reading.decisive: Same subject from the same sender received by many recipients (campaign), delivered to the inbox; message removed by ZAP after delivery; malicious attachment.
reading.context: Message from a new domain, with a URL or an HTML, SVG or archive attachment; Teams message from an external thread; messages sent or deleted by the mailbox from an unusual IP (Exchange audit).
reading.noise: Internal automatic notifications, calendar invitations.

rules.query:
// [EM-P1] Messages involving the address — Pivot / E-mail address
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 240) * 1m; // default: 4h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // default: 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Email address indicator.
let ValueMail = tolower(Value);
let ValueMailDomain = tostring(split(ValueMail, "@")[1]);
let ValueMailLocal = tostring(split(ValueMail, "@")[0]);
let Mails = EmailEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where RecipientEmailAddress =~ ValueMail or SenderFromAddress =~ ValueMail or SenderMailFromAddress =~ ValueMail;
let Campaign = EmailEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. (EndTimestamp + 1d))
    | where Subject in ((Mails | distinct Subject))
    | summarize SameSubjectRecipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress) by Subject, SenderFromAddress;
let PostDelivery = EmailPostDeliveryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. (EndTimestamp + 2d))
    | where NetworkMessageId in ((Mails | distinct NetworkMessageId))
    | summarize PostDeliveryActions = make_set(strcat(ActionType, " · ", Action, " · ", ActionResult,
        iff(isnotempty(DeliveryLocation), strcat(" → ", DeliveryLocation), "")), 10) by NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress;
let Urls = EmailUrlInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1h) .. (EndTimestamp + 1h))
    | where NetworkMessageId in ((Mails | distinct NetworkMessageId))
    | summarize UrlDomains = make_set(tolower(UrlDomain), 10) by NetworkMessageId;
let Attachments = EmailAttachmentInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1h) .. (EndTimestamp + 1h))
    | where NetworkMessageId in ((Mails | distinct NetworkMessageId))
    | summarize AttachmentNames = make_set(FileName, 10), MaliciousAttachments = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes))
        by NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress;
union isfuzzy=true
(
    Mails
    | join kind=leftouter (Campaign) on Subject, SenderFromAddress
    | join kind=leftouter (PostDelivery) on NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress
    | join kind=leftouter (Urls) on NetworkMessageId
    | join kind=leftouter (Attachments) on NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress
    | extend Role = iff(RecipientEmailAddress =~ ValueMail, "Recipient", "Sender")
    | project TimeGenerated, Role, SenderFromAddress, SenderMailFromAddress, SenderDisplayName, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject,
        SameSubjectRecipients, EmailDirection, DeliveryAction, LatestDeliveryLocation, LatestDeliveryAction, ThreatTypes,
        DetectionMethods, UrlCount, AttachmentCount, SenderIPv4, AuthenticationDetails, NetworkMessageId, InternetMessageId,
        PostDeliveryActions, UrlDomains, AttachmentNames, MaliciousAttachments, ClientIP = "", Source = "EmailEvents"
),
(
    MessageEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where SenderEmailAddress =~ ValueMail or RecipientDetails has ValueMail
    | extend Role = iff(SenderEmailAddress =~ ValueMail, "Sender (Teams)", "Recipient (Teams)")
    | project TimeGenerated, Role, SenderFromAddress = SenderEmailAddress, SenderMailFromAddress = "", SenderDisplayName,
        RecipientEmailAddress = iff(SenderEmailAddress =~ ValueMail, "", ValueMail), Subject = coalesce(MessageSubject, Subject, ThreadName),
        SameSubjectRecipients = long(null), EmailDirection = iff(IsExternalThread, "Teams (external thread)", "Teams"), DeliveryAction,
        LatestDeliveryLocation = DeliveryLocation, LatestDeliveryAction = "", ThreatTypes, DetectionMethods = tostring(DetectionMethods),
        UrlCount = int(null), AttachmentCount = int(null), SenderIPv4 = "", AuthenticationDetails = "", NetworkMessageId = TeamsMessageId,
        InternetMessageId = "", PostDeliveryActions = dynamic([]), UrlDomains = dynamic([]), AttachmentNames = dynamic([]),
        MaliciousAttachments = long(null), ClientIP = "", Source = "MessageEvents"
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where OfficeWorkload == "Exchange"
    | where Operation in~ ("Send", "SendAs", "SendOnBehalf", "SoftDelete", "HardDelete", "MoveToDeletedItems", "Move")
    | where UserId =~ ValueMail or MailboxOwnerUPN =~ ValueMail or SendAsUserSmtp =~ ValueMail or SendOnBehalfOfUserSmtp =~ ValueMail
    | extend It = parse_json(Item), Affected = parse_json(AffectedItems)
    | project TimeGenerated, Role = "Mailbox (Exchange audit)",
        SenderFromAddress = iff(Operation startswith "Send", coalesce(SendAsUserSmtp, SendOnBehalfOfUserSmtp, MailboxOwnerUPN, UserId), ""),
        SenderMailFromAddress = "", SenderDisplayName = "", RecipientEmailAddress = "",
        Subject = coalesce(tostring(It.Subject), tostring(Affected[0].Subject)), SameSubjectRecipients = long(null),
        EmailDirection = "Exchange audit", DeliveryAction = Operation, LatestDeliveryLocation = DestFolder, LatestDeliveryAction = ResultStatus,
        ThreatTypes = "", DetectionMethods = "", UrlCount = int(null), AttachmentCount = int(null), SenderIPv4 = "",
        AuthenticationDetails = ClientInfoString, NetworkMessageId = "",
        InternetMessageId = coalesce(tostring(It.InternetMessageId), tostring(Affected[0].InternetMessageId)),
        PostDeliveryActions = dynamic([]), UrlDomains = dynamic([]), AttachmentNames = dynamic([]), MaliciousAttachments = long(null),
        ClientIP, Source = "OfficeActivity (Exchange)"
)
// @sentinel-only:end
| sort by TimeGenerated asc

rules.name: Link clicks around T0
rules.description: Clicks recorded by link protection for the address (UrlClickEvents), 30 minutes before and after T0 by default, matched with the source email (sender, subject, time received).

reading.decisive: Allowed click (ClickAllowed) or click forced through the warning (IsClickedThrough) on the URL of the suspicious message.
reading.context: Click from Teams or Office rather than from Outlook.
reading.noise: Clicks by security scanners a few seconds after delivery, from datacenter IPs.

rules.name: Network connections of the user around T0
rules.description: Defender network connections (DeviceNetworkEvents) started by the user's processes, 5 minutes before and after T0 by default (time of the click, for instance). The match uses the process UPN, or otherwise the local part of the address (approximation when the Windows account name differs). MachineRole gives the known role of the device (an RDS or Citrix server hosts sessions from many users).

reading.decisive: Connection to the domain of the email or of the fake CAPTCHA, followed by a connection from a non-browser process.
reading.context: Public destinations never seen elsewhere in the fleet.
reading.noise: Background traffic from the browser, Teams and update agents.

rules.name: URLs and attachments of the messages
rules.description: URLs (EmailUrlInfo) and attachments (EmailAttachmentInfo) of the emails involving the address, with the number of clicks on each URL since receipt.

reading.decisive: Clicked URL to a new domain, or HTML, SVG, ISO, archive or script attachment flagged by Defender.
reading.context: QR code (URL extracted from an image), redirect chain.
reading.noise: Unsubscribe links, tracking pixels, signatures with links to social networks.

rules.name: Delivery and post-delivery actions
rules.description: For each email involving the address: initial delivery action and folder, then later actions (ZAP, manual removal, move by the user) from EmailPostDeliveryEvents.

reading.decisive: Message delivered to the inbox then removed by ZAP after a click by the user.
reading.context: Message moved out of junk email by the user.
reading.noise: Admin purges of campaigns already handled.

rules.name: Messages sent to the address
rules.description: Senders who sent messages to the address: useful when the address is the target of a forwarding rule (external address). Shows the direction (outbound), the number of forwarded messages and the subjects.

reading.decisive: Outbound messages to an external address right after a forwarding rule was created.
reading.context: Forwarding from several mailboxes to the same external address.
reading.noise: Authorized forwarding to partners, copies to ticketing tools.

rules.name: Teams messages involving the address
rules.description: Teams messages and chats sent by the address or including it: MessageEvents (Defender for Office 365, if available), Teams audit from OfficeActivity and CloudAppEvents. Shows whether the thread is external.

reading.decisive: Sender from an external tenant posing as the help desk, contacting several employees within the hour.
reading.context: First exchange with this sender, generic display name (Help Desk, IT Support).
reading.noise: Chats with known partners and vendors.

rules.name: Account behind the address
rules.description: Account holding the email address, then devices where this account signed in or logged on, one row per entity. The account is found in IdentityInfo by UPN, primary address or alias (MailAddress, EmailAddress, AdditionalMailAddresses and AccountUPN columns read with column_ifexists: they differ between Sentinel and Defender XDR), otherwise the address is used as UPN. Devices come from Entra ID sign-ins (fragment _Signins: SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs or EntraIdSignInEvents, DeviceDetail field) and Windows devices from logons seen by Defender for Endpoint (DeviceLogonEvents). Used to go from an address (phishing recipient) to the account and the workstations to examine.

reading.decisive: Account found in IdentityInfo whose UPN differs from the address (alias); unmanaged or non-compliant device used right after the message was received.
reading.context: Several accounts for the same address (admin account, synced account and cloud account); sign-ins from an unnamed device.
reading.noise: Shared mailboxes and distribution lists, which have no sign-in account of their own; RDS or Citrix servers shared by many users.

rules.name: Email, click, download, network, process timeline
rules.description: Full chain around T0 for the user: received emails, clicks, downloaded files, first contact with each public destination and processes started from Explorer, a browser or Office. Host carries the known role of the device (DC, declared RDS server…).

reading.decisive: Email → click → download or pasted command → process (powershell, mshta, script) → outbound connection.
reading.context: Short delay (under 5 minutes) between the click and the first unusual process.
reading.noise: Ordinary browsing, Office documents opened from Outlook.

rules.name: Source coverage
rules.description: State of the 25 sources read by the "Domain" rules (21 tables). A source is a table, or part of a logged table: for example SecurityEvent · file access (4656, 4660, 4663, 4670). For each one: table present or not, fed in the window, events actually collected (audit policy, data collection rule), missing columns used by the rules, and whether another source of the same family compensates. Run it first on a new environment: a missing source raises no error, it only returns empty results.

reading.decisive: A "Not covered" row: no source of the family is fed, the listed rules cannot show anything of that kind of event.
reading.context: An "Events not collected" row: the table is fed but not with these EventIDs (audit off, no SACL, data collection rule too narrow). "Missing columns": the schema differs, the matching branch is skipped.
reading.noise: A missing source "Compensated by" another: an equivalent source provides the same events.

rules.name: Domain occurrences per day and source
rules.description: Number of traces of the domain (and its subdomains) per day and per source: clicks, URLs in emails and Teams messages, Defender connections, file origins, DNS (DnsEvents, ASimDnsActivityLogs, Defender for Endpoint DNS responses) and proxy or firewall (CEF, ASIM web, Azure Firewall). For a URL, its domain is counted.

reading.decisive: Domain absent until the day before, then present in several sources on the day of the alert.
reading.context: DNS activity that continues after clicks are blocked (infected device calling back).
reading.noise: CDN, analytics or ad network domains present every day.

// Common URL / domain functions.
// _Host: host of a URL or a name (adds a scheme if missing so that parse_url works).
// _InDomain: true if the host is the domain or one of its subdomains.
let _Host = (u:string) { tolower(tostring(parse_url(iff(u contains "://", u, strcat("http://", u))).Host)) };
let _InDomain = (h:string, d:string) { isnotempty(d) and (h == d or h endswith strcat(".", d)) };
// URL and Domain indicators: ValueDomain is the URL host, or the value itself if it is a domain.
// @requires: web_functions
let ValueUrl = Value;
let ValueDomain = trim_end(@"\.", _Host(Value));
// Sysmon events (Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational log) normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// Event (Azure Monitor agent, EventData as XML) or WindowsEvent (event forwarding, EventData as JSON).
// Parameters: start, end, ids (EventIDs, empty = all), term (text pre-filter on event data and device name, empty = none).
// Sysmon columns (Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, User, Hashes, TargetFilename, ImageLoaded, TargetObject, Details,

// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// Returns nothing unless Sysmon is installed with a configuration that logs the requested EventIDs.
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _SysmonEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 1, "Process created",
        id == 2, "File creation time changed",
        id == 3, "Network connection",
        id == 5, "Process terminated",
        id == 6, "Driver loaded",

rules.description: First and last appearance of the domain over 30 days, number of distinct devices and accounts, per source and in total, with the subdomains seen and the number of exact matches of the selected URL.

// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());

let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 1d
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;

// Common URL / domain functions.
// _Host: host of a URL or a name (adds a scheme if missing so that parse_url works).
// _InDomain: true if the host is the domain or one of its subdomains.
let _Host = (u:string) { tolower(tostring(parse_url(iff(u contains "://", u, strcat("http://", u))).Host)) };
let _InDomain = (h:string, d:string) { isnotempty(d) and (h == d or h endswith strcat(".", d)) };

        | where _InDomain(tolower(Fqdn), d) or _InDomain(_Host(TargetUrl), d)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWApplicationRule", Host = SourceIp, Account = "", Url = coalesce(TargetUrl, Fqdn),
            Action = strcat("Azure Firewall ", Action)
    ),
    // Azure Firewall DNS proxy (Sentinel only)
    (
        AZFWDnsQuery
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where QueryName has d
        | extend Q = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", QueryName))
        | where _InDomain(Q, d)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "AZFWDnsQuery", Host = SourceIp, Account = "", Url = Q,
            Action = strcat("DNS ", QueryType, " · ", ResponseCode, " (Azure Firewall DNS proxy)")
    ),
    (
        _Sysmon(start, end, dynamic([3, 22]), d)
        | extend Q = tolower(trim_end(@"\.", iff(EventID == 22, QueryName, DestinationHostname)))
        | where _InDomain(Q, d)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Sysmon ", tostring(EventID)), Host = tolower(Computer), Account = UserSam, Url = Q,
            Action = strcat(iff(EventID == 22, "DNS · ", "Connection · "), ProcessFile)
    ),
    (
        CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where RequestURL has d or DestinationHostName has d
        | where _InDomain(_Host(RequestURL), d) or _InDomain(tolower(DestinationHostName), d)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), Host = tolower(coalesce(SourceHostName, SourceIP)),
            Account = tolower(SourceUserName), Url = coalesce(RequestURL, DestinationHostName), Action = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity)
    )
    // @sentinel-only:end
};
let Hits = materialize(_DomainHits(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, ValueDomain) | extend Fqdn = _Host(Url));
union
(
    Hits
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count(),
        Machines = dcountif(Host, isnotempty(Host)), Accounts = dcountif(Account, isnotempty(Account)),
        ExactUrlHits = countif(Url =~ ValueUrl), Subdomains = make_set(Fqdn, 20) by Source
),
(
    Hits
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count(),
        Machines = dcountif(Host, isnotempty(Host)), Accounts = dcountif(Account, isnotempty(Account)),
        ExactUrlHits = countif(Url =~ ValueUrl), Subdomains = make_set(Fqdn, 20)
    | extend Source = "Total"
)
| extend NewInWindow = FirstSeen > T0 - 2d
| project Source, NewInWindow, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Events, Machines, Accounts, ExactUrlHits, Subdomains
| sort by Source == "Total" desc, Events desc

rules.name: Discovery: where the value appears
rules.description: Looks for the value in every table (union * | where * has) and returns one row per table and location: column, or path in a JSON (for example RawEventData['1']['parameters']['ip']), likely role (source or destination), value alone or inside a text, and table statistics (volume, first and last seen, active hours, top devices, accounts and actions). Status compares each location with the columns the rules of the indicator read: "Not read by the rules" points to a source to add to the catalog. Expensive: keep a short window.

reading.decisive: A "Not read by the rules" location with exact rows: the value is there and no pivot looks at it.
reading.context: Tables where the value appears with many devices or accounts (shared IP, service account), or only in free text.
reading.noise: Matches in text fields (messages, command lines, URLs) that mention the value without carrying it.

    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where * has Term

    | extend Host = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.DeviceName), tostring(Row.Computer), tostring(Row.HostName), tostring(Row.DvcHostname),
          tostring(Row.SrcHostname), tostring(Row.SourceHostName))),
        Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.AccountName), tostring(Row.UserPrincipalName), tostring(Row.TargetUserName),

    | sort by Table asc
    | where row_number(1, prev(Table) != Table) <= SamplePerTable
    | mv-apply Cell = Row on (
        extend Column = tostring(bag_keys(Cell)[0])
        | extend Raw = Cell[Column]
        | where tostring(Raw) has Term
        | project Column, Raw)
    | project Table, Column, Path = Column, Text = substring(tostring(Raw), 0, 3000),
        V = iff(gettype(Raw) in ("dictionary", "array"), Raw, parse_json(tostring(Raw)))
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend Exact = tolower(tostring(V)) == tolower(Term) or tostring(V) == Value
    | extend Role = case(Path matches regex @"(?i)(src|source|client|caller|remote|initiat|sender|origin)", "source",
        Path matches regex @"(?i)(dst|dest|target|local|recipient|server)", "destination",
        "undetermined")
    | summarize LocationRows = count(), ExactRows = countif(Exact), Example = take_any(Text) by Table, Column, Path, Role;
Locations
| join kind=leftouter (Known) on Table, Column
| join kind=inner (PerTable) on Table
| extend Status = case(isempty(Rules), "Not read by the rules", Path == Column, "Read by the rules", "Column read, JSON path to check")
| extend Order = case(Status startswith "Not read", 0, Status startswith "Column", 1, 2)
| sort by Order asc, TableEvents desc
| project Table, Path, Role, Status, Rules, LocationRows, ExactRows, TableEvents, FirstSeen, LastSeen, ActiveHours,
    Hosts, Accounts, TopHosts, TopAccounts, TopActions, Example

// 1. A single pass over every table
let Hits = materialize(
    union isfuzzy=true withsource=Table *
    | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where * has Term
    | extend Row = pack_all(true));
// 2. Per-table statistics, over every row found
let PerTable = Hits
    | extend Host = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.DeviceName), tostring(Row.Computer), tostring(Row.HostName), tostring(Row.DvcHostname),
          tostring(Row.SrcHostname), tostring(Row.SourceHostName))),
        Account = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.AccountName), tostring(Row.UserPrincipalName), tostring(Row.TargetUserName),
          tostring(Row.SubjectUserName), tostring(Row.InitiatingProcessAccountName), tostring(Row.AccountUpn), tostring(Row.UserId),
          tostring(Row.Caller), tostring(Row.SrcUsername))),
        Action = coalesce(tostring(Row.ActionType), tostring(Row.EventID), tostring(Row.Operation), tostring(Row.OperationName),
          tostring(Row.ResultType), tostring(Row.DeviceAction))
    | summarize TableEvents = count(), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
        ActiveHours = dcount(bin(Timestamp, 1h)), Hosts = dcountif(Host, isnotempty(Host)), Accounts = dcountif(Account, isnotempty(Account)),
        TopHosts = make_set_if(Host, isnotempty(Host), 5), TopAccounts = make_set_if(Account, isnotempty(Account), 5),
        TopActions = make_set_if(Action, isnotempty(Action), 5)
        by Table;
// 3. Exact locations: column, or path in a JSON (5 levels), on a sample per table
let Locations = Hits
    | sort by Table asc
    | where row_number(1, prev(Table) != Table) <= SamplePerTable
    | mv-apply Cell = Row on (
        extend Column = tostring(bag_keys(Cell)[0])
        | extend Raw = Cell[Column]
        | where tostring(Raw) has Term
        | project Column, Raw)
    | project Table, Column, Path = Column, Text = substring(tostring(Raw), 0, 3000),
        V = iff(gettype(Raw) in ("dictionary", "array"), Raw, parse_json(tostring(Raw)))
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend _t = gettype(V)
    | extend _k = case(_t == "dictionary", bag_keys(V), _t == "array", range(0, array_length(V) - 1, 1), dynamic(["."]))
    | mv-expand _k
    | extend Path = case(_t == "dictionary", strcat(Path, "['", tostring(_k), "']"), _t == "array", strcat(Path, "[", tostring(_k), "]"), Path),
        V = case(_t == "dictionary", V[tostring(_k)], _t == "array", V[toint(_k)], V)
    | where tostring(V) has Term
    | extend Exact = tolower(tostring(V)) == tolower(Term) or tostring(V) == Value
    | extend Role = case(Path matches regex @"(?i)(src|source|client|caller|remote|initiat|sender|origin)", "source",
        Path matches regex @"(?i)(dst|dest|target|local|recipient|server)", "destination",
        "undetermined")
    | summarize LocationRows = count(), ExactRows = countif(Exact), Example = take_any(Text) by Table, Column, Path, Role;
Locations
| join kind=leftouter (Known) on Table, Column
| join kind=inner (PerTable) on Table
| extend Status = case(isempty(Rules), "Not read by the rules", Path == Column, "Read by the rules", "Column read, JSON path to check")
| extend Order = case(Status startswith "Not read", 0, Status startswith "Column", 1, 2)
| sort by Order asc, TableEvents desc
| project Table, Path, Role, Status, Rules, LocationRows, ExactRows, TableEvents, FirstSeen, LastSeen, ActiveHours,
    Hosts, Accounts, TopHosts, TopAccounts, TopActions, Example

rules.name: Users who clicked
rules.description: Clicks to the domain recorded by link protection (UrlClickEvents), per user: allowed clicks, blocked clicks, clicks through the warning, URLs, applications (Outlook, Teams, Office) and IPs. Completed by visits seen on workstations: browser connections to the domain (DeviceNetworkEvents, process account) and browser launches on a URL of the domain from another application, Outlook or Teams for instance (DeviceEvents, BrowserLaunchedToOpenUrl). In Sentinel, requests seen by the proxy are added (ASimWebSessionLogs, CommonSecurityLog: user authenticated by the proxy, IP and workstation name). Clicks, Allowed, Blocked and ClickedThrough only count UrlClickEvents; BrowserConnections, BrowserLaunches and ProxyRequests count the other sources.

reading.decisive: Allowed or clicked-through clicks (IsClickedThrough) by several users of the same campaign; browser opened on the URL from Outlook or Teams, followed by connections to the domain.
reading.context: Click from an IP other than that of the usual workstation (personal phone); visit seen only by the proxy or the workstation (copied link, message outside Defender for Office 365).
reading.noise: Only blocked clicks, clicks by automated scanners; proxy requests without a user (empty account); third-party resources loaded by a page.

rules.name: Emails containing the domain
rules.description: Emails with a URL pointing to the domain (EmailUrlInfo + EmailEvents), grouped by message: sender, subject, recipients, delivery and detected threats.

reading.decisive: Same message delivered to the inbox of many recipients.
reading.context: New external sender, subject imitating a brand (Booking, DocuSign, Microsoft).
reading.noise: Legitimate newsletters that mention the domain.

rules.name: Devices and processes in contact with the domain
rules.description: Devices, accounts and processes that contacted the domain (DeviceNetworkEvents), downloaded a file from the domain (DeviceFileEvents, origin or referrer) or mentioned it in a command line (DeviceProcessEvents). In Sentinel, Sysmon (22 DNS queries, 3 connections, with the process), workstations seen by the proxy (ASimWebSessionLogs, CommonSecurityLog, without process) and Azure Firewall (AZFWApplicationRule, AZFWDnsQuery: source IP only, without device name or process) complete Defender for Endpoint. MachineRole gives the known role of the device, AccountKind the category of the account (system, service).

reading.decisive: Non-browser process (powershell, mshta, curl, rclone, node) contacting the domain.
reading.context: File downloaded from the domain then executed on the same device.
reading.noise: Browsers loading third-party resources of the page.

rules.name: DNS resolutions and related IPs
rules.description: Names resolved in the domain and IP addresses returned: Windows DNS servers (DnsEvents), ASIM normalized DNS logs (ASimDnsActivityLogs), DNS responses seen by Defender for Endpoint (DeviceEvents), workstation DNS queries seen by Sysmon 22 (with the resolving process), queries through the Azure Firewall DNS proxy (AZFWDnsQuery: type and response code, without the returned IPs) and IPs actually contacted according to Defender (DeviceNetworkEvents). Gives the IPs to pivot on next (IP-P1, IP-P4).

reading.decisive: Destination IP shared with other known malicious domains, or recent hosting provider.
reading.context: Many distinct subdomains resolved (algorithmic generation, DNS tunnel).
reading.noise: CDN resolutions returning dozens of changing IPs.

// [DM-P4] DNS resolutions and related IPs — Pivot / Domain, URL
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 10080) * 1m; // default: 7d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 1d
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Common URL / domain functions.
// _Host: host of a URL or a name (adds a scheme if missing so that parse_url works).
// _InDomain: true if the host is the domain or one of its subdomains.
let _Host = (u:string) { tolower(tostring(parse_url(iff(u contains "://", u, strcat("http://", u))).Host)) };
let _InDomain = (h:string, d:string) { isnotempty(d) and (h == d or h endswith strcat(".", d)) };
// URL and Domain indicators: ValueDomain is the URL host, or the value itself if it is a domain.
// @requires: web_functions
let ValueUrl = Value;
let ValueDomain = trim_end(@"\.", _Host(Value));

rules.name: Files downloaded from the domain
rules.description: Files coming from the domain (or its subdomains), one row per file (hash): downloads whose origin URL or referrer is in the domain (DeviceFileEvents, FileOriginUrl and FileOriginReferrerUrl), attachments of messages containing a link to the domain (EmailUrlInfo matched with EmailAttachmentInfo on NetworkMessageId) and, in Sentinel, downloads seen by the proxy (ASimWebSessionLogs, CommonSecurityLog) and Zone.Identifier streams logged by Sysmon 15 (HostUrl, ReferrerUrl). Gives devices, accounts or recipients, URLs and the process that wrote the file. Pivot on the hashes next (HS-P1, HS-P2).

reading.decisive: Executable, script, archive or ISO downloaded from the domain then present on several devices; attachment of a message whose link points to the domain.
reading.context: Download where only the referrer is in the domain (redirect or lure page); written by a non-browser process.
reading.noise: Software vendor and update CDN domains; images and fonts of web pages.

rules.query:
// [DM-P5] Files downloaded from the domain — Pivot / Domain, URL
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 10080) * 1m; // default: 7d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 1d
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Common URL / domain functions.
// _Host: host of a URL or a name (adds a scheme if missing so that parse_url works).
// _InDomain: true if the host is the domain or one of its subdomains.
let _Host = (u:string) { tolower(tostring(parse_url(iff(u contains "://", u, strcat("http://", u))).Host)) };
let _InDomain = (h:string, d:string) { isnotempty(d) and (h == d or h endswith strcat(".", d)) };
// URL and Domain indicators: ValueDomain is the URL host, or the value itself if it is a domain.
// @requires: web_functions
let ValueUrl = Value;
let ValueDomain = trim_end(@"\.", _Host(Value));
// Sysmon events (Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational log) normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// Event (Azure Monitor agent, EventData as XML) or WindowsEvent (event forwarding, EventData as JSON).
// Parameters: start, end, ids (EventIDs, empty = all), term (text pre-filter on event data and device name, empty = none).
// Sysmon columns (Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, User, Hashes, TargetFilename, ImageLoaded, TargetObject, Details,
// SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname, QueryName, QueryResults...) and derived columns:
// Contents (Zone.Identifier stream of event 15: HostUrl and ReferrerUrl of the download).
// ProcessFile, ParentFile, TargetFile (lowercase file names), UserSam, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, RegistryEventType, EventName.
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// Returns nothing unless Sysmon is installed with a configuration that logs the requested EventIDs.
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _SysmonEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 1, "Process created",
        id == 2, "File creation time changed",
        id == 3, "Network connection",
        id == 5, "Process terminated",
        id == 6, "Driver loaded",
        id == 7, "Image (DLL) loaded",
        id == 8, "Remote thread created",
        id == 10, "Process accessed",
        id == 11, "File created",
        id == 12, "Registry key created or deleted",
        id == 13, "Registry value set",
        id == 14, "Registry key or value renamed",
        id == 15, "File stream created (ADS, Mark of the Web)",
        id == 17, "Named pipe created",
        id == 18, "Named pipe connected",
        id == 22, "DNS query",
        id == 23, "File deleted (archived)",
        id == 25, "Process tampering",
        id == 26, "File deleted",
        id == 29, "Executable detected",
        strcat("Sysmon ", tostring(id)))
};
