            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%1539", "%%1540", "WRITE_DAC", "WRITE_OWNER") or EventID == 4670, "permissions", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4421", "Execute"), "execute", "")), dynamic([""])), ", "), "")
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, TargetHost, AuthAuthority, SourceHost, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, AccessList, ObjectType, HandleId, ObjectValueName, ShareLocalPath, ObjectAccess, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
// @sentinel-only:end
let Downloads = DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileRenamed", "FileModified") and isnotempty(SHA256)
    | where isnotempty(FileOriginUrl) or FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Content.Outlook\", @"\INetCache\")
    | project DownloadTime = TimeGenerated, DeviceId, SHA256, DownloadedFile = FileName, FolderPath, FileOriginUrl,
        FileOriginReferrerUrl, Writer = InitiatingProcessFileName;
// Defender warnings and blocks related to a file of the device (SmartScreen, ASR, Exploit Guard)
let Warnings = DeviceEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1h) .. (EndTimestamp + 10m))
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where ActionType startswith "SmartScreen" or ActionType startswith "Asr" or ActionType startswith "ExploitGuard"
    | where isnotempty(FileName)
    | summarize Warnings = make_set(ActionType, 5) by FileKey = tolower(FileName);
// @sentinel-only:begin
let SysDownloads = _Sysmon(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([11, 15]), ValueShort)
    | where _IsHost(Computer)
    | extend PathKey = tolower(replace_regex(TargetFilename, @":Zone\.Identifier$", ""))
    | extend HostUrl = iff(EventID == 15, extract(@"HostUrl=(\S+)", 1, Contents), ""),
        Referrer = iff(EventID == 15, extract(@"ReferrerUrl=(\S+)", 1, Contents), "")
    | where isnotempty(HostUrl) or PathKey has_any (@"\downloads\", @"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\content.outlook\", @"\inetcache\")
    | summarize DownloadTime = min(TimeGenerated), FileOriginUrl = take_anyif(HostUrl, isnotempty(HostUrl)),
        FileOriginReferrerUrl = take_anyif(Referrer, isnotempty(Referrer)), Writer = take_any(ProcessFile),
        DownloadSHA256 = take_anyif(SHA256, isnotempty(SHA256)), DownloadSources = make_set(strcat("Sysmon ", tostring(EventID))),
        FolderPath = take_any(replace_regex(TargetFilename, @":Zone\.Identifier$", ""))
        by Machine = tolower(tostring(split(Computer, ".")[0])), PathKey;
let SysExecs = union isfuzzy=true
    (
        _Sysmon(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp + 10m, dynamic([1]), ValueShort)
        | where _IsHost(Computer)
        | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, Machine = tolower(tostring(split(Computer, ".")[0])), DeviceName = tolower(Computer),
            PathKey = tolower(Image), ExecutedFile = ProcessFile, ProcessCommandLine = CommandLine, Parent = ParentFile, AccountName = UserSam,
            ExecSHA256 = SHA256, ExecSource = "Sysmon 1"
    ),
    (
        _WinSecurity(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp + 10m, dynamic([4688]), ValueShort)
        | where _IsHost(Computer)
        | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, Machine = tolower(tostring(split(Computer, ".")[0])), DeviceName = tolower(Computer),
            PathKey = tolower(NewProcessName), ExecutedFile = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, @"\")[-1])), ProcessCommandLine = CommandLine,
            Parent = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, @"\")[-1])), AccountName = SubjectSam, ExecSHA256 = "",
            ExecSource = strcat("4688 (", SourceTable, ")")
    );
// @sentinel-only:end
union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. (EndTimestamp + 10m))
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | project ExecTime = TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceName, SHA256, ExecutedFile = FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
        Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName, AccountName
    | join kind=inner (Downloads) on DeviceId, SHA256
    | where ExecTime between (DownloadTime .. (DownloadTime + 10m))
    | extend Sources = "DeviceFileEvents → DeviceProcessEvents"
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    SysExecs
    | join kind=inner (SysDownloads) on Machine, PathKey
    | where ExecTime between (DownloadTime .. (DownloadTime + 10m))
    | extend SHA256 = coalesce(ExecSHA256, DownloadSHA256), DownloadedFile = tostring(split(FolderPath, @"\")[-1]),
        Sources = strcat(strcat_array(DownloadSources, " + "), " → ", ExecSource)
)
// @sentinel-only:end
| extend DelaySeconds = datetime_diff("second", ExecTime, DownloadTime), FileKey = tolower(DownloadedFile)
| lookup kind=leftouter (Warnings) on FileKey
| project DownloadTime, ExecTime, DelaySeconds, DeviceName, AccountName, DownloadedFile, FolderPath, FileOriginUrl,
    FileOriginReferrerUrl, Writer, Parent, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, Sources, Warnings
| sort by DownloadTime asc

rules.name: Device role and identity
rules.description: Tells what the device is before pivoting on it: known role (domain controller detected by its 4768 events, its LDAP queries seen by Defender for Identity or its Kerberos listener, role declared in the EasyPivotRoles watchlist), Defender for Endpoint inventory (OS, type, group, exposure, asset value, join type, logged-on users, public IP), IP addresses, Azure Monitor agent (Heartbeat) and tables that see it over the window. A domain controller or an infrastructure server shows up in the logs of almost every account: pivots MC-P1 and AC-P2 flag it, this rule explains why.

reading.decisive: Critical device (DC, sensitive server, Internet-facing) involved in the alert.
reading.context: Device without Defender inventory (not onboarded) or without agent, so visible only through other sources.
reading.noise: Infrastructure servers (DC, file, monitoring) that show up in every pivot.

rules.name: Files and shares accessed on the device
rules.description: Who accessed which files and shares of the device, grouped by account, folder and access kind: network share access (5140, 5145) and file access audited by SACL (4656, 4663, 4670, and 4660 linked to the file through its handle) logged by the device, files written remotely over SMB (Defender for Endpoint, RequestAccountName), files created or deleted seen by Sysmon (11, 23, 26) and ASIM file logs. Useful on a file server: reads only appear in the Windows audit.

reading.decisive: An account reading a share in bulk that it does not usually use, or access to administrative shares (C$, ADMIN$).
reading.context: Files dropped remotely over SMB then executed (lateral movement); permissions changed.
reading.noise: Backup, antivirus, indexing, folder redirection and roaming profiles.

rules.query:
// [MC-P6] Files and shares accessed on the device — Pivot / Device
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 24h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // default: 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Device indicator: case-insensitive match on the short name (before the first dot),
// to reconcile DeviceName (Defender FQDN) and Computer (Windows FQDN or NetBIOS).
let ValueHost = tolower(Value);
let ValueShort = tostring(split(ValueHost, ".")[0]);
let _IsHost = (h:string) { tolower(tostring(split(h, ".")[0])) == ValueShort };
let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Successful logon",
        id == 4625, "Failed logon",
        id == 4634, "Logoff",
        id == 4647, "User-initiated logoff",
        id == 4648, "Logon with explicit credentials",
        id == 4656, "Handle to an object requested",
        id == 4657, "Registry value modified",
        id == 4658, "Handle closed",
        id == 4660, "Object deleted",
        id == 4663, "Object access",
        id == 4670, "Object permissions changed",
        id == 4672, "Special privileges assigned",
        id == 4688, "Process created",
        id == 4697, "Service installed",
        id == 4698, "Scheduled task created",
        id == 4702, "Scheduled task updated",
        id == 4720, "User account created",
        id == 4722, "User account enabled",
        id == 4724, "Password reset",
        id == 4728, "Member added to a security-enabled global group",
        id == 4732, "Member added to a security-enabled local group",
        id == 4740, "Account locked out",
        id == 4756, "Member added to a security-enabled universal group",
        id == 4768, "Kerberos TGT requested",
        id == 4769, "Kerberos service ticket requested",
        id == 4771, "Kerberos pre-authentication failed",
        id == 4776, "NTLM credential validation",
        id == 4778, "RDP session reconnected",
        id == 4779, "RDP session disconnected",
        id == 5140, "Network share accessed",
        id == 5145, "Network share object access check",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)
};
// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(CommandLine, extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TaskContent = coalesce(extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(MemberName, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

// and flags entities that skew a pivot (domain controller, NAT, proxy, service account...).
// Three combined sources:
// 1. automatic domain controller (DC) detection: hosts emitting 4768 (only a KDC does), LDAP targets seen by
//    Defender for Identity, devices accepting Kerberos connections (port 88) according to Defender for Endpoint;
// 2. Sentinel watchlist "EasyPivotRoles" (columns Entity, Type, Role, Note), template in watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv;
//    Type values (case-insensitive): Machine/Host/Device, IP/CIDR/Subnet, Account/User (French values still accepted);
// 3. accounts: IdentityInfo (Entra ID roles, privileged AD groups, service account, Defender for Identity tags)
//    and reserved names (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync).
// Each function takes the reference time `at` and looks at the preceding day (14 days for IdentityInfo).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks are removed from the Defender XDR variant (tables missing in Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h): lowercase short name (FQDN, NetBIOS, machine account "PC01$" -> "pc01"); empty for an IP address.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a): SAM name of an account, from "DOMAIN\name", "name@domain" or "name".
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(name, role): "dc01 [DC]", to annotate lists (make_set) without adding a column.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };

let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(SAM name): category inferred from the name alone.

        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "System account",
        sam == "krbtgt", "KDC account (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Entra Connect sync",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Built-in administrator",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at): devices (and IPs) that behave like domain controllers.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "LDAP target (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepts Kerberos on port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at): MachineKey (short name), MachineRole ("DC, File server"), MachineRoleBasis (evidence).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at): Ip (exact address or CIDR range), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at): known roles of an address, including membership in a watchlist CIDR range.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at): AccountKey (lowercase SAM name or UPN), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Entra ID role assigned"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Privileged AD group", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Service account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Sensitive account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Honeytoken account", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};
// @sentinel-only:begin
let Win = materialize(_WinSecurity(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([4656, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140, 5145]), ValueShort)
    | where _IsHost(Computer)
    | where EventID in (5140, 5145) or ObjectType in ("File", ""));
let Handles = Win | where EventID in (4656, 4663) and isnotempty(HandleId) | summarize HandleObject = take_any(ObjectName) by Computer, HandleId;
// @sentinel-only:end
union isfuzzy=true
// @sentinel-only:begin
(
    Win
    | join kind=leftouter (Handles) on Computer, HandleId
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = SourceTable, Account = tolower(strcat(SubjectDomainName, @"\", SubjectUserName)),
        Kind = iff(EventID in (5140, 5145), "Network share", "File (Windows audit)"),
        Object = case(EventID == 5145, strcat(trim(@"[\\*]+", ShareName), @"\", RelativeTargetName), EventID == 5140, trim(@"[\\*]+", ShareName),
            coalesce(ObjectName, HandleObject)),
        Access = ObjectAccess, Process = tolower(tostring(split(ProcessName, @"\")[-1])), SourceIp = IpAddress
),
// @sentinel-only:end
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where isnotempty(RequestAccountName) and RequestProtocol == "Smb"
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceFileEvents", Account = tolower(strcat(RequestAccountDomain, @"\", RequestAccountName)),
        Kind = "Remote write (SMB, Defender)", Object = FolderPath,
        Access = case(ActionType == "FileDeleted", "delete", ActionType == "FileRenamed", "rename", "write"),
        Process = tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), SourceIp = RequestSourceIP
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    _Sysmon(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([11, 23, 26]), ValueShort)
    | where Computer startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(Computer)
    | where UserSam !in ("system", "local service", "network service")
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Sysmon ", tostring(EventID)), Account = tolower(User), Kind = "File (Sysmon)",
        Object = TargetFilename, Access = iff(EventID == 11, "write", "delete"), Process = ProcessFile, SourceIp = ""
),
(
    ASimFileEventLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DvcHostname startswith ValueShort and _IsHost(DvcHostname)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASIM ", EventProduct), Account = tolower(ActorUsername), Kind = "File (ASIM)",
        Object = TargetFilePath, Access = tolower(EventType), Process = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, @"\")[-1])), SourceIp = SrcIpAddr
)
// @sentinel-only:end
| where isnotempty(Object)
| where not(Account endswith "$") and not(Account has_any (@"nt authority\", @"window manager\", @"font driver host\"))
| extend Folder = tostring(parse_path(Object).DirectoryPath), File = tostring(parse_path(Object).Filename)
| extend AccountKey = _SamOf(Account)
| summarize Events = count(), Files = dcount(Object), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    SampleFiles = make_set(File, 10), Processes = make_set_if(Process, isnotempty(Process), 5),
    SourceIps = make_set_if(SourceIp, isnotempty(SourceIp), 5), Sources = make_set(Source)
    by Account, AccountKey, Kind, Folder = coalesce(Folder, Object), Access
| lookup kind=leftouter (_AccountRoles(EndTimestamp)) on AccountKey
| extend AccountRole = _JoinRoles(_AccountKind(AccountKey), AccountRole)
| project Account, AccountRole, Kind, Folder, Access, Files, Events, FirstSeen, LastSeen, SampleFiles, Processes, SourceIps, Sources
| sort by Files desc, FirstSeen asc

rules.name: IP addresses of the device
rules.description: IP addresses held by the device over the period, one row per address, with first seen, last seen and sources. Direct sources: network adapter addresses (DeviceNetworkInfo, with adapter, MAC and address type), public egress IP (DeviceInfo), local IP of network connections (DeviceNetworkEvents, useful for VPNs and virtual adapters), Azure Monitor agent IP (Heartbeat, public IP and private IPs) and Linux device IP (Syslog). Indirect sources, seen by other devices: remote workstation IP (DeviceLogonEvents of a server), source workstation IP seen by Defender for Identity, and IP of the self-reported source workstation in the 4624, 4625, 4648, 4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776 events logged by domain controllers and servers. Reverse of IP-P1: gives the IPs to pivot on next (firewall, proxy, cloud sign-ins). The known role of the IP (DC, NAT, VPN…: EasyPivotRoles watchlist) is shown.

reading.decisive: IP assigned by DeviceNetworkInfo, Heartbeat or Syslog over the period (high confidence); this is the address to search for in firewall and proxy logs around T0.
reading.context: IP seen only as a source workstation by other devices (4624, DeviceLogonEvents); public egress IP shared by a whole site.
reading.noise: Virtual adapter addresses (Hyper-V, Docker, WSL), link-local addresses (169.254, fe80) and NAT or VPN IPs held by many devices.

rules.query:
// [MC-P7] IP addresses of the device — Pivot / Device
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 24h
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // default: 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Device indicator: case-insensitive match on the short name (before the first dot),
// to reconcile DeviceName (Defender FQDN) and Computer (Windows FQDN or NetBIOS).
let ValueHost = tolower(Value);
let ValueShort = tostring(split(ValueHost, ".")[0]);
let _IsHost = (h:string) { tolower(tostring(split(h, ".")[0])) == ValueShort };
let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Successful logon",
        id == 4625, "Failed logon",
        id == 4634, "Logoff",
        id == 4647, "User-initiated logoff",
        id == 4648, "Logon with explicit credentials",
        id == 4656, "Handle to an object requested",
        id == 4657, "Registry value modified",
        id == 4658, "Handle closed",
        id == 4660, "Object deleted",
        id == 4663, "Object access",
        id == 4670, "Object permissions changed",
        id == 4672, "Special privileges assigned",
        id == 4688, "Process created",
        id == 4697, "Service installed",
        id == 4698, "Scheduled task created",
        id == 4702, "Scheduled task updated",
        id == 4720, "User account created",
        id == 4722, "User account enabled",
        id == 4724, "Password reset",
        id == 4728, "Member added to a security-enabled global group",
        id == 4732, "Member added to a security-enabled local group",
        id == 4740, "Account locked out",
        id == 4756, "Member added to a security-enabled universal group",
        id == 4768, "Kerberos TGT requested",
        id == 4769, "Kerberos service ticket requested",
        id == 4771, "Kerberos pre-authentication failed",
        id == 4776, "NTLM credential validation",
        id == 4778, "RDP session reconnected",
        id == 4779, "RDP session disconnected",
        id == 5140, "Network share accessed",
        id == 5145, "Network share object access check",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)
};
// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(IpPort, extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(ProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(ElevatedToken, extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(Status, extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(SubStatus, extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(ServiceName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TicketOptions = extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(TargetServerName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(NewProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(ParentProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(CommandLine, extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TaskContent = coalesce(extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(MemberName, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(MemberSid, extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(ServiceFileName, extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(ShareName, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(RelativeTargetName, extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(ObjectName, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(AccessMask, extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessList = extract(@'<Data Name="AccessList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ObjectType = coalesce(ObjectType, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            HandleId = coalesce(HandleId, extract(@'<Data Name="HandleId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectValueName = coalesce(ObjectValueName, extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectValueName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareLocalPath = coalesce(ShareLocalPath, extract(@'<Data Name="ShareLocalPath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(PrivilegeList, extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "SecurityEvent"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AuthenticationPackageName), tostring(EventData.PackageName), extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.WorkstationName), tostring(EventData.Workstation), extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpPort), tostring(EventData.ClientPort), extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskContent = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskContent), tostring(EventData.TaskContentNew), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberName), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceFileName), tostring(EventData.ImagePath), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareName), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.RelativeTargetName), extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessMask), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessList), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectType), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            HandleId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.HandleId), extract(@'<Data Name="HandleId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectValueName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectValueName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectValueName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareLocalPath = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareLocalPath), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareLocalPath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | extend _svcAccount = tolower(tostring(split(ServiceName, "@")[0]))
    | extend TargetHost = tolower(case(
            EventID == 4769 and _svcAccount endswith "$", trim_end(@"\$", _svcAccount),
            EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), "",
            EventID == 4648 and isnotempty(TargetServerName) and TargetServerName !in~ ("-", "localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"), TargetServerName,
            Computer)),
        AuthAuthority = iff(EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), tolower(Computer), ""),
        SourceHost = tolower(coalesce(WorkstationName, IpAddress))
    // Rights requested on an object (4656, 4663, 5145: AccessList %%44xx codes; 4660: delete; 4670: permissions)
    | extend ObjectAccess = iff(EventID in (4656, 4658, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140, 5145, 4657), strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4416", "%%4419", "%%4423", "ReadData") or EventID == 5140, "read", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4417", "%%4418", "%%4420", "%%4424", "WriteData", "AppendData") or EventID == 4657, "write", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%1537", "DELETE") or EventID == 4660, "delete", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%1539", "%%1540", "WRITE_DAC", "WRITE_OWNER") or EventID == 4670, "permissions", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4421", "Execute"), "execute", "")), dynamic([""])), ", "), "")
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, TargetHost, AuthAuthority, SourceHost, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, AccessList, ObjectType, HandleId, ObjectValueName, ShareLocalPath, ObjectAccess, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
// @sentinel-only:end
// Entity roles (devices, IPs, accounts): separates "where the event is logged" from "where the entity is used"
// and flags entities that skew a pivot (domain controller, NAT, proxy, service account...).
// Three combined sources:
// 1. automatic domain controller (DC) detection: hosts emitting 4768 (only a KDC does), LDAP targets seen by
//    Defender for Identity, devices accepting Kerberos connections (port 88) according to Defender for Endpoint;
// 2. Sentinel watchlist "EasyPivotRoles" (columns Entity, Type, Role, Note), template in watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv;
//    Type values (case-insensitive): Machine/Host/Device, IP/CIDR/Subnet, Account/User (French values still accepted);
// 3. accounts: IdentityInfo (Entra ID roles, privileged AD groups, service account, Defender for Identity tags)
//    and reserved names (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync).
// Each function takes the reference time `at` and looks at the preceding day (14 days for IdentityInfo).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks are removed from the Defender XDR variant (tables missing in Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h): lowercase short name (FQDN, NetBIOS, machine account "PC01$" -> "pc01"); empty for an IP address.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a): SAM name of an account, from "DOMAIN\name", "name@domain" or "name".
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(name, role): "dc01 [DC]", to annotate lists (make_set) without adding a column.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b): joins two role labels, skipping empty ones.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(SAM name): category inferred from the name alone.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Machine account",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "System account",
        sam == "krbtgt", "KDC account (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Entra Connect sync",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Built-in administrator",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at): devices (and IPs) that behave like domain controllers.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "LDAP target (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepts Kerberos on port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at): MachineKey (short name), MachineRole ("DC, File server"), MachineRoleBasis (evidence).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at): Ip (exact address or CIDR range), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at): known roles of an address, including membership in a watchlist CIDR range.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at): AccountKey (lowercase SAM name or UPN), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Entra ID role assigned"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Privileged AD group", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Service account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Sensitive account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Honeytoken account", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};
union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceNetworkInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | mv-expand IpEntry = IPAddresses
    | extend Ip = tostring(IpEntry.IPAddress)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Ip, Machine = tolower(DeviceName),
        Evidence = strcat("Adapter ", NetworkAdapterName, " (", MacAddress, ", ", NetworkAdapterStatus, ", ", tostring(IpEntry.AddressType), ")"),
        Source = "DeviceNetworkInfo"
),
(
    DeviceInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where isnotempty(PublicIP)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Ip = PublicIP, Machine = tolower(DeviceName), Evidence = "Public egress IP", Source = "DeviceInfo"
),
(
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where isnotempty(LocalIP)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Ip = LocalIP, Machine = tolower(DeviceName), Evidence = strcat("Local IP of network connections (", LocalIPType, ")"),
        Source = "DeviceNetworkEvents"
),
// @sentinel-only:begin
(
    Heartbeat
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTimestamp - 1d) .. EndTimestamp)
    | where Computer startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(Computer)
    | extend Ips = array_concat(pack_array(ComputerIP), iff(isnull(ComputerPrivateIPs), dynamic([]), ComputerPrivateIPs))
    | mv-expand Ip = Ips to typeof(string)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Ip, Machine = tolower(Computer),
        Evidence = iff(Ip == ComputerIP, "Azure Monitor agent IP", "Azure Monitor agent private IP"), Source = "Heartbeat"
),
(
    Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where Computer startswith ValueShort or HostName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(Computer) or _IsHost(HostName)
    | where isnotempty(HostIP)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Ip = HostIP, Machine = tolower(Computer), Evidence = "Linux device IP (Syslog)", Source = "Syslog"
),
// @sentinel-only:end
(
    DeviceLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where RemoteDeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(RemoteDeviceName)
    | where isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Ip = RemoteIP, Machine = tolower(RemoteDeviceName), Evidence = strcat("Remote workstation seen by ", tolower(DeviceName)),
        Source = "DeviceLogonEvents"
),
(
    IdentityLogonEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where DeviceName startswith ValueShort
    | where _IsHost(DeviceName)
    | where isnotempty(IPAddress)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Ip = IPAddress, Machine = tolower(DeviceName), Evidence = strcat("Source ", Protocol, " to ", Application),
        Source = "IdentityLogonEvents"
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    _WinSecurity(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([4624, 4625, 4648, 4768, 4769, 4771, 4776]), ValueShort)
    | where isnotempty(WorkstationName) and _IsHost(WorkstationName)
    | where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress != "-"
    | extend Ip = trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count()
        by Ip, Machine = tolower(WorkstationName), Evidence = strcat("Self-reported source workstation, seen by ", tolower(Computer)),
        Source = SourceTable
)
// @sentinel-only:end
| where isnotempty(Ip) and Ip !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1", "0.0.0.0", "::", "-")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(FirstSeen), LastSeen = max(LastSeen), Events = sum(Events),
    Machines = make_set(Machine, 5), Evidence = make_set(Evidence, 10), Sources = make_set(Source) by Ip
| extend IpType = case(
    Ip startswith "169.254." or Ip startswith "fe80:", "Link-local",
    Ip contains ":", iff(Ip startswith "fc" or Ip startswith "fd", "Private IPv6", "IPv6"),
    ipv4_is_private(Ip), "Private",
    "Public")
| lookup kind=leftouter (_IpRoles(EndTimestamp) | where Ip !has "/" | project Ip, IpRole) on Ip
| extend ConfidenceRank = case(
    set_has_element(Sources, "DeviceNetworkInfo") or set_has_element(Sources, "DeviceNetworkEvents")
    // @sentinel-only:begin
        or set_has_element(Sources, "Heartbeat") or set_has_element(Sources, "Syslog")
    // @sentinel-only:end
        , 1,
    set_has_element(Sources, "DeviceInfo"), 2,
    array_length(Sources) > 1, 3,
    4)
| extend Confidence = case(ConfidenceRank == 1, "High: IP held by the device",
    ConfidenceRank == 2, "High: public egress IP (shared by the site)",
    ConfidenceRank == 3, "Medium: seen by several sources",
    "Low: seen by a single indirect source")
| sort by ConfidenceRank asc, LastSeen desc
| project IPAddress = Ip, IpType, IpRole, Confidence, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Events, Evidence, Sources, Machines

rules.name: Device timeline
rules.description: Sequence around T0 on the device: processes, first contact with each public destination, executable files, scripts and archives written, logons, persistence keys, notable Defender events (antivirus, ASR, tampering, injection, tasks, services), alerts and key Windows events (4624, 4625, 4672, 4688, 4697, 4698, 4720, 4732), access seen by Defender for Identity, processes and authentications from ASIM logs, Sysmon (process, connections, files, registry, DNS), files modified or deleted and shares accessed according to the Windows audit (4660, 4663, 5145), and notable Linux logs (SSH, sudo, errors). Limited to 5,000 rows.

reading.decisive: Unusual process → dropped file → persistence → outbound connection chain, with a related alert.
reading.context: Remote logon just before the suspicious activity (inbound lateral movement).
reading.noise: Background activity (updates, management agents, antivirus).

rules.query:
// [MC-T1] Device timeline — Timeline / Device
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 30) * 1m; // default: 30m
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 30) * 1m; // default: 30m
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Device indicator: case-insensitive match on the short name (before the first dot),
// to reconcile DeviceName (Defender FQDN) and Computer (Windows FQDN or NetBIOS).
let ValueHost = tolower(Value);
let ValueShort = tostring(split(ValueHost, ".")[0]);
let _IsHost = (h:string) { tolower(tostring(split(h, ".")[0])) == ValueShort };
// Registry keys and Defender actions associated with persistence.
let _PersistenceKeys = dynamic([
    @"\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\CurrentVersion\RunOnce", @"\CurrentVersion\RunServices",
    @"\Policies\Explorer\Run", @"\CurrentVersion\Winlogon", @"\Image File Execution Options",
    @"\CurrentControlSet\Services", @"\Explorer\Shell Folders", @"\Explorer\User Shell Folders",
    @"\Session Manager\BootExecute", @"\Windows\AppInit_DLLs", @"\Environment\UserInitMprLogonScript"]);
let _PersistenceActions = dynamic(["ScheduledTaskCreated", "ScheduledTaskUpdated", "ServiceInstalled",
    "WmiBindEventFilterToConsumer"]);
let _IsPersistenceKey = (key:string, valueName:string) {
    key has_any (_PersistenceKeys)
    and (key !has @"\CurrentControlSet\Services" or valueName in~ ("ImagePath", "ServiceDll", "FailureCommand"))
};
let _WinEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 4624, "Successful logon",
        id == 4625, "Failed logon",
        id == 4634, "Logoff",
        id == 4647, "User-initiated logoff",
        id == 4648, "Logon with explicit credentials",
        id == 4656, "Handle to an object requested",
        id == 4657, "Registry value modified",
        id == 4658, "Handle closed",
        id == 4660, "Object deleted",
        id == 4663, "Object access",
        id == 4670, "Object permissions changed",
        id == 4672, "Special privileges assigned",
        id == 4688, "Process created",
        id == 4697, "Service installed",
        id == 4698, "Scheduled task created",
        id == 4702, "Scheduled task updated",
        id == 4720, "User account created",
        id == 4722, "User account enabled",
        id == 4724, "Password reset",
        id == 4728, "Member added to a security-enabled global group",
        id == 4732, "Member added to a security-enabled local group",
        id == 4740, "Account locked out",
        id == 4756, "Member added to a security-enabled universal group",
        id == 4768, "Kerberos TGT requested",
        id == 4769, "Kerberos service ticket requested",
        id == 4771, "Kerberos pre-authentication failed",
        id == 4776, "NTLM credential validation",
        id == 4778, "RDP session reconnected",
        id == 4779, "RDP session disconnected",
        id == 5140, "Network share accessed",
        id == 5145, "Network share object access check",
        strcat("EventID ", tostring(id)))
};
let _LogonTypeName = (t:string) {
    case(
        t == "2", "Interactive",
        t == "3", "Network",
        t == "4", "Batch",
        t == "5", "Service",
        t == "7", "Unlock",
        t == "8", "NetworkCleartext",
        t == "9", "NewCredentials",
        t == "10", "RemoteInteractive",
        t == "11", "CachedInteractive",
        t)
};
// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

        | extend SourceTable = "SecurityEvent"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            WorkstationName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.WorkstationName), tostring(EventData.Workstation), extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            ObjectValueName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectValueName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectValueName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareLocalPath = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareLocalPath), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareLocalPath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | extend _svcAccount = tolower(tostring(split(ServiceName, "@")[0]))
    | extend TargetHost = tolower(case(

            EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), "",

            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%1539", "%%1540", "WRITE_DAC", "WRITE_OWNER") or EventID == 4670, "permissions", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4421", "Execute"), "execute", "")), dynamic([""])), ", "), "")
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, TargetHost, AuthAuthority, SourceHost, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, AccessList, ObjectType, HandleId, ObjectValueName, ShareLocalPath, ObjectAccess, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam

let _SysmonEventName = (id:int) {

        id == 1, "Process created",
        id == 2, "File creation time changed",
        id == 3, "Network connection",
        id == 5, "Process terminated",
        id == 6, "Driver loaded",
        id == 7, "Image (DLL) loaded",
        id == 8, "Remote thread created",
        id == 10, "Process accessed",

rules.name: Source coverage
rules.description: State of the 23 sources read by the "Process" rules (12 tables). A source is a table, or part of a logged table: for example SecurityEvent · file access (4656, 4660, 4663, 4670). For each one: table present or not, fed in the window, events actually collected (audit policy, data collection rule), missing columns used by the rules, and whether another source of the same family compensates. Run it first on a new environment: a missing source raises no error, it only returns empty results.

reading.decisive: A "Not covered" row: no source of the family is fed, the listed rules cannot show anything of that kind of event.
reading.context: An "Events not collected" row: the table is fed but not with these EventIDs (audit off, no SACL, data collection rule too narrow). "Missing columns": the schema differs, the matching branch is skipped.
reading.noise: A missing source "Compensated by" another: an equivalent source provides the same events.

rules.name: Process prevalence
rules.description: Executions of the binary over 30 days, per path (user profile replaced by *): devices, accounts, active days, hashes, vendors and parents. Spots a legitimate binary launched from an abnormal location (node.exe in AppData, copy of rundll32). Also covers Windows 4688, Sysmon 1 (with hash and vendor) and ASIM normalized processes (Sysmon, Linux, third-party EDR). Sample devices carry their known role (DC, declared server). The HOST context restricts to one device.

reading.decisive: User-writable path (AppData, Temp, ProgramData) seen on 1 to 3 devices, without a known vendor.
reading.context: Several hashes for the same name and path, original name (OriginalFileName) different from the name.
reading.noise: Development tools (node, python) on developer workstations.

// [PR-S1] Process prevalence — Statistics / Process
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}, {{HOST}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 43200) * 1m; // default: 30d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 1d
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
let HostFilter = tolower(tostring(split(trim(@"\s", iff(@"{{HOST}}" startswith "{{", "", @"{{HOST}}")), ".")[0]));
// Process indicator: file name (powershell.exe) or full path
let ValueFile = tolower(tostring(split(replace_string(Value, "/", @"\"), @"\")[-1]));
let ValuePath = iff(Value contains @"\" or Value contains "/", tolower(replace_string(Value, "/", @"\")), "");
// _NormPath: normalized file path
// (c:\users\jdoe\appdata\... -> c:\users\*\appdata\...) to group the same binary across users.
let _NormPath = (p:string) {
    let l = tolower(p);
    let u = indexof(l, @"\users\");
    let next = iff(u < 0, -1, indexof(l, @"\", u + 7));
    iff(u < 0 or next < 0, l, strcat(substring(l, 0, u + 7), "*", substring(l, next)))
};
// _IsUserWritable: folder a standard user can write to (unusual location for an executable).
let _IsUserWritable = (p:string) {
    tolower(p) has_any (@"\appdata\", @"\temp\", @"\downloads\", @"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\desktop\", @"\perflogs\")
};
