// Windows security events normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// for SecurityEvent, fields are re-parsed from the EventData XML when columns are empty (ingestion bugs), with a regex added at build time.
// Parameters: start, end (window), ids (EventID list, empty = all), term (text pre-filter, empty = none;
// searched in the raw XML and in the account, device, IP and process columns).
// Columns added so the logging device is not mistaken for the device actually used:
// - TargetHost: device actually targeted. 4769: the device of the requested service (ServiceName "FS01$"); 4648: TargetServerName;
//   4768, 4771, 4776: empty (credential validation only, the target is unknown); otherwise: Computer.
// - AuthAuthority: device that validated the credentials (DC, or the device itself for a local account over NTLM) for
//   4768, 4769, 4771 and 4776; empty otherwise.
// - SourceHost: declared source workstation (WorkstationName), otherwise the source IP.
// - ObjectAccess: rights requested on a file, key or share (read, write, delete, permissions,
//   execute) for 4656, 4657, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140 and 5145 ("File System", "Registry", "Detailed File Share"
//   auditing: nothing is produced without an audit policy and, for files and registry, without a SACL).
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// @requires: win_names
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, PackageName, extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(WorkstationName, Workstation, extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(IpAddress, ClientAddress, extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

// Entity roles (devices, IPs, accounts): separates "where the event is logged" from "where the entity is used"
// and flags entities that skew a pivot (domain controller, NAT, proxy, service account...).
// Three combined sources:
// 1. automatic domain controller (DC) detection: hosts emitting 4768 (only a KDC does), LDAP targets seen by
//    Defender for Identity, devices accepting Kerberos connections (port 88) according to Defender for Endpoint;
// 2. Sentinel watchlist "EasyPivotRoles" (columns Entity, Type, Role, Note), template in watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv;
//    Type values (case-insensitive): Machine/Host/Device, IP/CIDR/Subnet, Account/User (French values still accepted);
// 3. accounts: IdentityInfo (Entra ID roles, privileged AD groups, service account, Defender for Identity tags)
//    and reserved names (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync).
// Each function takes the reference time `at` and looks at the preceding day (14 days for IdentityInfo).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks are removed from the Defender XDR variant (tables missing in Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h): lowercase short name (FQDN, NetBIOS, machine account "PC01$" -> "pc01"); empty for an IP address.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a): SAM name of an account, from "DOMAIN\name", "name@domain" or "name".
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(name, role): "dc01 [DC]", to annotate lists (make_set) without adding a column.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b): joins two role labels, skipping empty ones.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(SAM name): category inferred from the name alone.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Machine account",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "System account",
        sam == "krbtgt", "KDC account (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Entra Connect sync",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Built-in administrator",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at): devices (and IPs) that behave like domain controllers.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "LDAP target (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepts Kerberos on port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at): MachineKey (short name), MachineRole ("DC, File server"), MachineRoleBasis (evidence).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at): Ip (exact address or CIDR range), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at): known roles of an address, including membership in a watchlist CIDR range.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at): AccountKey (lowercase SAM name or UPN), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Entra ID role assigned"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Privileged AD group", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Service account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Sensitive account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Honeytoken account", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};

// Event (Azure Monitor agent, EventData as XML) or WindowsEvent (event forwarding, EventData as JSON).

// Sysmon columns (Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, User, Hashes, TargetFilename, ImageLoaded, TargetObject, Details,
// SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname, QueryName, QueryResults...) and derived columns:

let _SysmonEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 1, "Process created",
        id == 2, "File creation time changed",
        id == 3, "Network connection",
        id == 5, "Process terminated",
        id == 6, "Driver loaded",
        id == 7, "Image (DLL) loaded",
        id == 8, "Remote thread created",
        id == 10, "Process accessed",
        id == 11, "File created",
        id == 12, "Registry key created or deleted",
        id == 13, "Registry value set",
        id == 14, "Registry key or value renamed",
        id == 15, "File stream created (ADS, Mark of the Web)",
        id == 17, "Named pipe created",
        id == 18, "Named pipe connected",
        id == 22, "DNS query",
        id == 23, "File deleted (archived)",
        id == 25, "Process tampering",
        id == 26, "File deleted",
        id == 29, "Executable detected",

            ParentCommandLine = extract(@'<Data Name="ParentCommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ParentProcessGuid = extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessGuid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Hashes = extract(@'<Data Name="Hashes">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),

rules.name: Discovery: where the value appears
rules.description: Looks for the value in every table (union * | where * has) and returns one row per table and location: column, or path in a JSON (for example RawEventData['1']['parameters']['ip']), likely role (source or destination), value alone or inside a text, and table statistics (volume, first and last seen, active hours, top devices, accounts and actions). Status compares each location with the columns the rules of the indicator read: "Not read by the rules" points to a source to add to the catalog. Expensive: keep a short window.

reading.decisive: A "Not read by the rules" location with exact rows: the value is there and no pivot looks at it.
reading.context: Tables where the value appears with many devices or accounts (shared IP, service account), or only in free text.
reading.noise: Matches in text fields (messages, command lines, URLs) that mention the value without carrying it.

let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());

let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // default: 1h

let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
// Process indicator: file name (powershell.exe) or full path

    union isfuzzy=true withsource=Table *
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where * has Term

// 2. Per-table statistics, over every row found
let PerTable = Hits
    | extend Host = tolower(coalesce(tostring(Row.DeviceName), tostring(Row.Computer), tostring(Row.HostName), tostring(Row.DvcHostname),

        Action = coalesce(tostring(Row.ActionType), tostring(Row.EventID), tostring(Row.Operation), tostring(Row.OperationName),

    | summarize TableEvents = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),

// 3. Exact locations: column, or path in a JSON (5 levels), on a sample per table

    | where row_number(1, prev(Table) != Table) <= SamplePerTable

rules.name: Process parents and children
rules.description: Tree around the process: its parents and grandparents (when it is launched) and its children (what it launches), with command lines, devices and accounts. Sources: DeviceProcessEvents, Windows 4688, Sysmon 1 and ASIM normalized processes (Sysmon, Linux, third-party EDR). The known role of the devices (DC, declared server) and the category of the accounts (system, service) are shown in brackets. For instance, from explorer.exe you see the executables launched by the user; from powershell.exe you see who launched it and with which options. If the value is a full path, only that path is kept.

reading.decisive: powershell, mshta or cmd launched by explorer or a browser with a URL or Base64 (ClickFix), or by Office.
reading.context: LOLBin child (rundll32, regsvr32, certutil, msbuild, node) of an unusual process.
reading.noise: Admin scripts launched by management agents (SCCM, Intune, RMM).

let _WinSecurity = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term or IpAddress has term or TargetUserName has term
            or SubjectUserName has term or WorkstationName has term or NewProcessName has term or ParentProcessName has term
            or TargetServerName has term
        | extend _x = tostring(EventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(SubjectUserSid, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(SubjectUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(SubjectDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(SubjectLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(TargetUserSid, TargetSid, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(TargetUserName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(TargetDomainName, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(TargetLogonId, extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

            LogonProcessName = coalesce(LogonProcessName, extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),

        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            SubjectUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserSid), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubjectLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubjectLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="SubjectLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserSid), tostring(EventData.TargetSid), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetUserName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetUserName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetDomainName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetDomainName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetDomainName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetLogonId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetLogonId), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetLogonId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonType), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            LogonProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.LogonProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="LogonProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AuthenticationPackageName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AuthenticationPackageName), tostring(EventData.PackageName), extract(@'<Data Name="AuthenticationPackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="PackageName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            WorkstationName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.WorkstationName), tostring(EventData.Workstation), extract(@'<Data Name="WorkstationName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="Workstation">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpAddress = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpAddress), tostring(EventData.ClientAddress), extract(@'<Data Name="IpAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientAddress">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IpPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IpPort), tostring(EventData.ClientPort), extract(@'<Data Name="IpPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ClientPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ElevatedToken = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ElevatedToken), extract(@'<Data Name="ElevatedToken">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Status = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Status), extract(@'<Data Name="Status">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SubStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SubStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="SubStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceName), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketEncryptionType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketEncryptionType), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketEncryptionType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TicketOptions = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), extract(@'<Data Name="TicketOptions">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetServerName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetServerName), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetServerName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            NewProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.NewProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="NewProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessName), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskName), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TaskContent = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TaskContent), tostring(EventData.TaskContentNew), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContent">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="TaskContentNew">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberName), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            MemberSid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.MemberSid), extract(@'<Data Name="MemberSid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ServiceFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ServiceFileName), tostring(EventData.ImagePath), extract(@'<Data Name="ServiceFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x), extract(@'<Data Name="ImagePath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareName), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            RelativeTargetName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.RelativeTargetName), extract(@'<Data Name="RelativeTargetName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessMask = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessMask), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessMask">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            AccessList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.AccessList), extract(@'<Data Name="AccessList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectType), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            HandleId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.HandleId), extract(@'<Data Name="HandleId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ObjectValueName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ObjectValueName), extract(@'<Data Name="ObjectValueName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ShareLocalPath = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ShareLocalPath), extract(@'<Data Name="ShareLocalPath">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            PrivilegeList = coalesce(tostring(EventData.PrivilegeList), extract(@'<Data Name="PrivilegeList">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"

    | extend IpAddress = iff(IpAddress == "-", "", trim_start(@"::ffff:", IpAddress))
    | extend WorkstationName = iff(WorkstationName == "-", "", trim_start(@"\\\\", WorkstationName))
    | extend TargetSam = tolower(tostring(split(TargetUserName, "@")[0])), SubjectSam = tolower(SubjectUserName)
    | extend EventName = _WinEventName(EventID), LogonTypeName = _LogonTypeName(LogonType)
    | extend _svcAccount = tolower(tostring(split(ServiceName, "@")[0]))
    | extend TargetHost = tolower(case(
            EventID == 4769 and _svcAccount endswith "$", trim_end(@"\$", _svcAccount),
            EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), "",
            EventID == 4648 and isnotempty(TargetServerName) and TargetServerName !in~ ("-", "localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"), TargetServerName,
            Computer)),
        AuthAuthority = iff(EventID in (4768, 4769, 4771, 4776), tolower(Computer), ""),
        SourceHost = tolower(coalesce(WorkstationName, IpAddress))
    // Rights requested on an object (4656, 4663, 5145: AccessList %%44xx codes; 4660: delete; 4670: permissions)
    | extend ObjectAccess = iff(EventID in (4656, 4658, 4660, 4663, 4670, 5140, 5145, 4657), strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4416", "%%4419", "%%4423", "ReadData") or EventID == 5140, "read", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4417", "%%4418", "%%4420", "%%4424", "WriteData", "AppendData") or EventID == 4657, "write", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%1537", "DELETE") or EventID == 4660, "delete", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%1539", "%%1540", "WRITE_DAC", "WRITE_OWNER") or EventID == 4670, "permissions", ""),
            iff(AccessList has_any ("%%4421", "Execute"), "execute", "")), dynamic([""])), ", "), "")
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, TargetHost, AuthAuthority, SourceHost, EventID, EventName, SubjectUserSid, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, SubjectLogonId, TargetUserSid, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, TargetLogonId, LogonType, LogonProcessName, AuthenticationPackageName, WorkstationName, IpAddress, IpPort, ProcessName, ElevatedToken, Status, SubStatus, ServiceName, TicketEncryptionType, TicketOptions, TargetServerName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, TaskName, TaskContent, MemberName, MemberSid, ServiceFileName, ShareName, RelativeTargetName, ObjectName, AccessMask, AccessList, ObjectType, HandleId, ObjectValueName, ShareLocalPath, ObjectAccess, PrivilegeList, LogonTypeName, TargetSam, SubjectSam
};
// @sentinel-only:end
// Entity roles (devices, IPs, accounts): separates "where the event is logged" from "where the entity is used"
// and flags entities that skew a pivot (domain controller, NAT, proxy, service account...).
// Three combined sources:
// 1. automatic domain controller (DC) detection: hosts emitting 4768 (only a KDC does), LDAP targets seen by
//    Defender for Identity, devices accepting Kerberos connections (port 88) according to Defender for Endpoint;
// 2. Sentinel watchlist "EasyPivotRoles" (columns Entity, Type, Role, Note), template in watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv;
//    Type values (case-insensitive): Machine/Host/Device, IP/CIDR/Subnet, Account/User (French values still accepted);
// 3. accounts: IdentityInfo (Entra ID roles, privileged AD groups, service account, Defender for Identity tags)
//    and reserved names (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync).
// Each function takes the reference time `at` and looks at the preceding day (14 days for IdentityInfo).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks are removed from the Defender XDR variant (tables missing in Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h): lowercase short name (FQDN, NetBIOS, machine account "PC01$" -> "pc01"); empty for an IP address.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a): SAM name of an account, from "DOMAIN\name", "name@domain" or "name".
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(name, role): "dc01 [DC]", to annotate lists (make_set) without adding a column.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b): joins two role labels, skipping empty ones.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(SAM name): category inferred from the name alone.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Machine account",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "System account",
        sam == "krbtgt", "KDC account (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Entra Connect sync",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Built-in administrator",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at): devices (and IPs) that behave like domain controllers.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "LDAP target (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepts Kerberos on port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at): MachineKey (short name), MachineRole ("DC, File server"), MachineRoleBasis (evidence).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at): Ip (exact address or CIDR range), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at): known roles of an address, including membership in a watchlist CIDR range.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at): AccountKey (lowercase SAM name or UPN), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Entra ID role assigned"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Privileged AD group", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Service account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Sensitive account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Honeytoken account", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};
// Sysmon events (Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational log) normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// Event (Azure Monitor agent, EventData as XML) or WindowsEvent (event forwarding, EventData as JSON).
// Parameters: start, end, ids (EventIDs, empty = all), term (text pre-filter on event data and device name, empty = none).
// Sysmon columns (Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, User, Hashes, TargetFilename, ImageLoaded, TargetObject, Details,
// SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname, QueryName, QueryResults...) and derived columns:
// Contents (Zone.Identifier stream of event 15: HostUrl and ReferrerUrl of the download).
// ProcessFile, ParentFile, TargetFile (lowercase file names), UserSam, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, RegistryEventType, EventName.
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).

rules.name: Process network connections
rules.description: Destinations contacted by the process (DeviceNetworkEvents, and Sysmon 3 in Sentinel): URL or IP, port, address type, number of connections, first and last contact, devices (with their known role: DC, declared server) and command lines.

reading.decisive: Script engine or LOLBin (powershell, mshta, rundll32, node) contacting a recent public destination.
reading.context: IP destination without a domain name (C2 resolved outside DNS, for instance through a blockchain).
reading.noise: Vendor updates and telemetry.

rules.name: Files created or modified by the process
rules.description: Files created, modified, renamed or deleted by the process: Defender for Endpoint (DeviceFileEvents) and, in Sentinel, file access audited by SACL (4656, 4660, 4663, 4670: the only source for reads) and Sysmon (11 file created, 15 Zone.Identifier stream with the origin URL, 23 and 26 deletions). For instance, from notepad.exe you find the modified files; from 7z.exe or winrar.exe, the archives created. MachineRole gives the known role of the device (DC, declared server).

reading.decisive: Large archive created in a temporary or public folder before an outbound transfer, or executable dropped in AppData.
reading.context: Files renamed in bulk (encryption), write to the Startup folder.
reading.noise: Temporary files and caches of the application.

rules.name: Registry, tasks and services modified by the process
rules.description: Persistence changes made by the process: sensitive registry keys (DeviceRegistryEvents), scheduled tasks and services (DeviceEvents), and schtasks, reg, sc commands it launched (DeviceProcessEvents); in Sentinel, registry seen by Sysmon (12, 13, 14) and by the Windows audit (4657, with SACL). MachineRole gives the known role of the device (DC, declared server).

reading.decisive: Unknown script or binary creating a scheduled task or a Run key pointing to a file it has just dropped.
reading.context: Change to Image File Execution Options or Winlogon.
reading.noise: Signed installers creating their update tasks.

rules.name: Process timeline
rules.description: Sequence around T0 of what the process does: launches (with its parent), children, network connections (first contact per destination), files written and registry keys modified (Defender for Endpoint), completed in Sentinel by Sysmon (1, 3, 11, 13, 22, 23, 26) and ASIM normalized processes. The device carries its known role (DC, declared server). Limited to 5,000 rows. Fill in the HOST context to follow a single device.

reading.decisive: Launch from an unusual parent → dropped file → LOLBin child → outbound connection.
reading.context: Persistence keys written by the process.
reading.noise: Normal activity of a very common process (explorer, svchost) without a device filter.

rules.name: Source coverage
rules.description: State of the 11 sources read by the "Application" rules (11 tables). A source is a table, or part of a logged table: for example SecurityEvent · file access (4656, 4660, 4663, 4670). For each one: table present or not, fed in the window, events actually collected (audit policy, data collection rule), missing columns used by the rules, and whether another source of the same family compensates. Run it first on a new environment: a missing source raises no error, it only returns empty results.

reading.decisive: A "Not covered" row: no source of the family is fed, the listed rules cannot show anything of that kind of event.
reading.context: An "Events not collected" row: the table is fed but not with these EventIDs (audit off, no SACL, data collection rule too narrow). "Missing columns": the schema differs, the matching branch is skipped.
reading.noise: A missing source "Compensated by" another: an equivalent source provides the same events.

rules.name: Application usage by IP
rules.description: Sign-ins and calls of the application (AppId, service principal ID or name) over 14 days, by source and by IP: service principal, managed identity, users through the application, Microsoft Graph and legacy Azure AD Graph (AADGraphActivityLogs). Builds the baseline of usual IPs (CI, servers) and flags the IPs that appeared in the last two days. Application sign-ins come from Sentinel or, failing that, from EntraIdSpnSignInEvents (Defender XDR); AppOrigin tells whether the application is published by Microsoft, by the tenant or by another tenant.

reading.decisive: IP never seen for this application, from a hosting provider or an unusual country, using a client secret.
reading.context: Sudden increase in Graph calls or authentication failures.
reading.noise: CI/CD runners whose IPs change, developer workstation testing locally.

rules.name: Discovery: where the value appears
rules.description: Looks for the value in every table (union * | where * has) and returns one row per table and location: column, or path in a JSON (for example RawEventData['1']['parameters']['ip']), likely role (source or destination), value alone or inside a text, and table statistics (volume, first and last seen, active hours, top devices, accounts and actions). Status compares each location with the columns the rules of the indicator read: "Not read by the rules" points to a source to add to the catalog. Expensive: keep a short window.

reading.decisive: A "Not read by the rules" location with exact rows: the value is there and no pivot looks at it.
reading.context: Tables where the value appears with many devices or accounts (shared IP, service account), or only in free text.
reading.noise: Matches in text fields (messages, command lines, URLs) that mention the value without carrying it.

rules.name: Application consents, permissions and secrets
rules.description: Entra ID audit events about the application: consents (user or admin), delegated permissions and app roles granted, owners, secrets and certificates added. Extracts the consent type and the scopes. Completed by the same operations seen by Defender for Cloud Apps (CloudAppEvents) when AuditLogs is not collected. Service principal sign-ins (one row per resource, IP and result) show whether the application used its permissions after the consent.

reading.decisive: User consent to an unknown multi-tenant application with Mail.Read, Files.ReadWrite.All or offline_access.
reading.context: New secret added to an existing application by an account that does not own it.
reading.noise: Consents to approved enterprise applications (video conferencing, CRM, e-signature).

rules.name: Service principal sign-ins and calls
rules.description: Sign-ins of the service principal or managed identity (IP, resource, result, credential type) and Microsoft Graph requests (and legacy Azure AD Graph, AADGraphActivityLogs) of the application grouped by method and path (identifiers replaced by {id}). Sign-ins read from AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs and AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs, or from EntraIdSpnSignInEvents (Defender XDR) when they are missing. In the Defender XDR variant, with no Graph log, the Microsoft 365 activity of the application is read from CloudAppEvents (OAuthAppId). AppOrigin tells whether the application is published by Microsoft, by the tenant or by another tenant (third-party multi-tenant application).

reading.decisive: Successful sign-ins with a client secret from an IP outside the baseline, followed by bulk-read Graph calls (messages, files, users).
reading.context: High failure rate (secret being tested), unusual resources (Key Vault, Azure Resource Manager).
reading.noise: Secret rotation, automated deployments.

rules.name: Devices and accounts using the application
rules.description: Users of the application and the devices they sign in from, one row per account and device pair: Entra ID sign-ins to the application (_Signins fragment: SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs or EntraIdSignInEvents, filtered on AppId or display name; device taken from DeviceDetail: name, OS, managed, compliant) and activity recorded by Defender for Cloud Apps (CloudAppEvents, filtered on OAuthAppId or application name; device type and OS only). In Sentinel, adds the Microsoft Graph calls made with the application on behalf of a user (MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs, filtered on AppId: account and device found in the sign-ins by their identifiers, otherwise the raw object ID), which show a token being used without a new sign-in. Gives the IPs, failures and sources. Complements AP-P2 (sign-ins of the service principal itself) on the delegated user side.

reading.decisive: Account using the application for the first time right after a consent (AP-P1), from an unmanaged device or an unknown IP.
reading.context: Application used by a single account; many non-interactive sign-ins (refresh token reused); delegated Graph calls from an IP absent from the sign-ins.
reading.noise: Microsoft and line-of-business applications used by the whole tenant (Teams, Outlook, Office); prefer the AppId of a third-party application.

rules.name: Source coverage
rules.description: State of the 20 sources read by the "Hash" rules (17 tables). A source is a table, or part of a logged table: for example SecurityEvent · file access (4656, 4660, 4663, 4670). For each one: table present or not, fed in the window, events actually collected (audit policy, data collection rule), missing columns used by the rules, and whether another source of the same family compensates. Run it first on a new environment: a missing source raises no error, it only returns empty results.

reading.decisive: A "Not covered" row: no source of the family is fed, the listed rules cannot show anything of that kind of event.
reading.context: An "Events not collected" row: the table is fed but not with these EventIDs (audit off, no SACL, data collection rule too narrow). "Missing columns": the schema differs, the matching branch is skipped.
reading.noise: A missing source "Compensated by" another: an equivalent source provides the same events.

| mv-expand Family = Families to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter (Fed) on Family

| sort by Order asc, Member asc
| project Status, Source = Member, Events, LastEvent, Impact, MissingColumns = Missing, Families, Rules,

    (IdentityInfo | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize Events = count(), LastEvent = max(Timestamp) | extend Member = "IdentityInfo"),
    (EmailAttachmentInfo | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize Events = count(), LastEvent = max(Timestamp) | extend Member = "EmailAttachmentInfo"),
    (EmailEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize Events = count(), LastEvent = max(Timestamp) | extend Member = "EmailEvents");
let TableVolume = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(Table:string, TableEvents:long) []),
    (IdentityQueryEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "IdentityQueryEvents"),
    (DeviceProcessEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "DeviceProcessEvents"),
    (DeviceFileEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "DeviceFileEvents"),
    (DeviceImageLoadEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "DeviceImageLoadEvents"),
    (DeviceEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "DeviceEvents"),
    (DeviceNetworkEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "DeviceNetworkEvents"),
    (IdentityInfo | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "IdentityInfo"),
    (EmailAttachmentInfo | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "EmailAttachmentInfo"),
    (EmailEvents | where Timestamp between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp) | summarize TableEvents = count() | extend Table = "EmailEvents");
let Present = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(Table:string, PresentColumns:dynamic) []),
    (IdentityQueryEvents | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "IdentityQueryEvents"),
    (DeviceProcessEvents | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "DeviceProcessEvents"),
    (DeviceFileEvents | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "DeviceFileEvents"),
    (DeviceImageLoadEvents | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "DeviceImageLoadEvents"),
    (DeviceEvents | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "DeviceEvents"),
    (DeviceNetworkEvents | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "DeviceNetworkEvents"),
    (IdentityInfo | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "IdentityInfo"),
    (EmailAttachmentInfo | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "EmailAttachmentInfo"),
    (EmailEvents | getschema | summarize PresentColumns = make_set(ColumnName) | extend Table = "EmailEvents");
let Rows = materialize(Expected
    | join kind=leftouter (Volume) on Member
    | join kind=leftouter (TableVolume) on Table
    | join kind=leftouter (Present) on Table
    | extend Exists = isnotnull(TableEvents) or isnotnull(PresentColumns)
    | extend MissingColumns = iff(isnotnull(PresentColumns), set_difference(Columns, PresentColumns), dynamic([]))
    | extend Status = case(not(Exists), "Missing or inaccessible", isnull(TableEvents) or isnull(Events), "Missing columns",
        TableEvents == 0, "Empty in the window", Events == 0, "Events not collected",
        array_length(MissingColumns) > 0, "Missing columns", "Fed"));
let Fed = Rows
    | mv-expand Family = Families to typeof(string)
    | summarize FedMembers = make_set_if(Member, Status == "Fed") by Family;
Rows
| mv-expand Family = Families to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter (Fed) on Family
| extend FedMembers = iff(array_length(FedMembers) == 0, dynamic([""]), FedMembers)
| mv-expand Alt = FedMembers to typeof(string)
| summarize Families = make_set(Family), Alternatives = make_set_if(Alt, isnotempty(Alt) and Alt != Member),
    Uncovered = make_set_if(Family, isempty(Alt)), FamilyHints = make_set_if(tostring(Hints[Family]), isempty(Alt))
    by Member, Status, Optional, MemberHint, Events, LastEvent, Missing = strcat_array(MissingColumns, ", "), Rules = strcat_array(Rules, ", ")
| extend Impact = case(Status == "Fed", "",
    Optional, "Optional: role enrichment only",
    array_length(Uncovered) > 0, strcat("Not covered: ", strcat_array(Uncovered, ", "), ". Incomplete results for ", Rules),
    strcat("Compensated by ", strcat_array(Alternatives, ", ")))
| extend Order = case(Status == "Fed", 4, Optional, 3, array_length(Uncovered) > 0, 0, Status == "Missing columns", 1, 2)
| sort by Order asc, Member asc
| project Status, Source = Member, Events, LastEvent, Impact, MissingColumns = Missing, Families, Rules,
    Remediation = iff(Status == "Fed" or Optional, "", iff(isnotempty(MemberHint), MemberHint, strcat_array(FamilyHints, " ")))

rules.name: Hash prevalence
rules.description: Presence of the file (MD5, SHA1 or SHA256) over 30 days, by source: files written, processes started, DLLs loaded, Defender events and email attachments (SHA256 only). Gives devices, names and paths, and a total row. In Sentinel, adds Sysmon (1, 7, 15, 23, 26, 29), ASIM normalized files and processes and downloads seen by the proxy (ASimWebSessionLogs, CommonSecurityLog). The HOST context narrows the search to one device.

reading.decisive: File seen on a single device, under a known software name, in a user folder.
reading.context: Same hash received as an attachment then executed on several devices.
reading.noise: Binaries of recent updates, not yet widespread.

// Sysmon events (Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational log) normalized, whatever the ingestion table:

    ASimProcessEventLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)

    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DvcHostname startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "ASimProcessEventLogs", DeviceName = tolower(DvcHostname), FileName = TargetProcessFilename,

),

    ASimWebSessionLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)

(
    _Sysmon(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([1, 7, 15, 23, 26, 29]), ValueHash)
    | where SHA256 == ValueHash or SHA1 == ValueHash or MD5 == ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Computer startswith HostFilter
    | extend Path = case(EventID == 1, Image, EventID == 7, ImageLoaded, TargetFilename)
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("Sysmon ", tostring(EventID)), DeviceName = tolower(Computer), FileName = tolower(tostring(split(Path, @"\")[-1])),

);
union
(
    H
    | summarize Events = count(), Machines = dcount(DeviceName), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
        FileNames = make_set(FileName, 10), Paths = make_set(FolderPath, 10) by Source

(

    | summarize Events = count(), Machines = dcount(DeviceName), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
        FileNames = make_set(FileName, 10), Paths = make_set(FolderPath, 10)
    | extend Source = "Total"
)
| project Source, Events, Machines, FirstSeen, LastSeen, FileNames, Paths
| sort by Source == "Total" desc, Events desc

rules.name: Discovery: where the value appears
rules.description: Looks for the value in every table (union * | where * has) and returns one row per table and location: column, or path in a JSON (for example RawEventData['1']['parameters']['ip']), likely role (source or destination), value alone or inside a text, and table statistics (volume, first and last seen, active hours, top devices, accounts and actions). Status compares each location with the columns the rules of the indicator read: "Not read by the rules" points to a source to add to the catalog. Expensive: keep a short window.

reading.decisive: A "Not read by the rules" location with exact rows: the value is there and no pivot looks at it.
reading.context: Tables where the value appears with many devices or accounts (shared IP, service account), or only in free text.
reading.noise: Matches in text fields (messages, command lines, URLs) that mention the value without carrying it.

rules.description: Devices, paths and names under which the file appears, with the actions seen (written, executed, loaded), the originating accounts and processes. Defender for Endpoint, completed in Sentinel by ASIM normalized files and processes and by Sysmon (1 process, 7 DLL loaded, 15 file stream, 23 and 26 delete, 29 executable detected). // [HS-P1] Devices and paths of the file — Pivot / Hash
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}, {{HOST}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 43200) * 1m; // default: 30d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 1440) * 1m; // default: 1d
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
let HostFilter = tolower(tostring(split(trim(@"\s", iff(@"{{HOST}}" startswith "{{", "", @"{{HOST}}")), ".")[0]));
// Hash indicator: MD5 (32), SHA1 (40) or SHA256 (64).
let ValueHash = tolower(Value);
// Entity roles (devices, IPs, accounts): separates "where the event is logged" from "where the entity is used"
// and flags entities that skew a pivot (domain controller, NAT, proxy, service account...).
// Three combined sources:
// 1. automatic domain controller (DC) detection: hosts emitting 4768 (only a KDC does), LDAP targets seen by
//    Defender for Identity, devices accepting Kerberos connections (port 88) according to Defender for Endpoint;
// 2. Sentinel watchlist "EasyPivotRoles" (columns Entity, Type, Role, Note), template in watchlists/EasyPivotRoles.csv;
//    Type values (case-insensitive): Machine/Host/Device, IP/CIDR/Subnet, Account/User (French values still accepted);
// 3. accounts: IdentityInfo (Entra ID roles, privileged AD groups, service account, Defender for Identity tags)
//    and reserved names (machine account, system account, krbtgt, Entra Connect sync).
// Each function takes the reference time `at` and looks at the preceding day (14 days for IdentityInfo).
// "@sentinel-only" blocks are removed from the Defender XDR variant (tables missing in Defender).
//
// _HostKey(h): lowercase short name (FQDN, NetBIOS, machine account "PC01$" -> "pc01"); empty for an IP address.
let _HostKey = (h:string) {
    iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(h)) or h contains ":", "", tolower(tostring(split(trim_end(@"\$", trim(@"[\s\\]+", h)), ".")[0])))
};
// _SamOf(a): SAM name of an account, from "DOMAIN\name", "name@domain" or "name".
let _SamOf = (a:string) { tolower(tostring(split(tostring(split(a, "@")[0]), @"\")[-1])) };
// _Labeled(name, role): "dc01 [DC]", to annotate lists (make_set) without adding a column.
let _Labeled = (name:string, role:string) { iff(isempty(role), name, strcat(name, " [", role, "]")) };
// _JoinRoles(a, b): joins two role labels, skipping empty ones.
let _JoinRoles = (a:string, b:string) { strcat_array(set_difference(pack_array(a, b), dynamic([""])), ", ") };
// _AccountKind(SAM name): category inferred from the name alone.
let _AccountKind = (sam:string) {
    case(
        sam endswith "$", "Machine account",
        sam in ("system", "local system", "local service", "network service", "anonymous logon", "iusr", "-")
            or sam startswith "dwm-" or sam startswith "umfd-", "System account",
        sam == "krbtgt", "KDC account (krbtgt)",
        sam startswith "msol_" or sam startswith "sync_" or sam startswith "aad_" or sam startswith "adtoaadsyncserviceaccount",
            "Entra Connect sync",
        sam in ("administrator", "administrateur"), "Built-in administrator",
        "")
};
// _DcEvidence(at): devices (and IPs) that behave like domain controllers.
let _DcEvidence = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Machine:string, Ip:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:begin
    (
        SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing" and EventID == 4768
        | summarize by Computer
        | project Machine = Computer, Ip = "", Basis = "Emits 4768 events (KDC)"
    ),
    // @sentinel-only:end
    (
        IdentityQueryEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where Protocol =~ "Ldap" and isnotempty(DestinationDeviceName)
        | summarize by DestinationDeviceName, DestinationIPAddress
        | project Machine = DestinationDeviceName, Ip = DestinationIPAddress, Basis = "LDAP target (Defender for Identity)"
    ),
    (
        DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 1d) .. at)
        | where LocalPort == 88 and ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted", "ListeningConnectionCreated")
        | summarize by DeviceName, LocalIP
        | project Machine = DeviceName, Ip = LocalIP, Basis = "Accepts Kerberos on port 88 (Defender for Endpoint)"
    )
};
// _MachineRoles(at): MachineKey (short name), MachineRole ("DC, File server"), MachineRoleBasis (evidence).
let _MachineRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(MachineKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(Machine), Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("machine", "host", "device", "serveur", "poste")
        | project MachineKey = _HostKey(tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(MachineKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize MachineRoles = make_set(Role), MachineRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by MachineKey
    | project MachineKey, MachineRole = strcat_array(MachineRoles, ", "), MachineRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoles(at): Ip (exact address or CIDR range), IpRole, IpRoleBasis.
let _IpRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(Ip:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        _DcEvidence(at)
        | where isnotempty(Ip)
        | project Ip, Role = "DC", Basis
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("ip", "plage", "cidr", "subnet", "réseau")
        | project Ip = trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)), Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role),
            Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(Ip) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize IpRoles = make_set(Role), IpRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by Ip
    | project Ip, IpRole = strcat_array(IpRoles, ", "), IpRoleBasis
};
// _IpRoleOf(ip, at): known roles of an address, including membership in a watchlist CIDR range.
let _IpRoleOf = (ip:string, at:datetime) {
    toscalar(_IpRoles(at)
        | where Ip == ip or (Ip has "/" and ipv4_is_in_range(ip, Ip))
        | summarize Roles = strcat_array(make_set(IpRole), ", "))
};
// _AccountRoles(at): AccountKey (lowercase SAM name or UPN), AccountRole, AccountRoleBasis.
let _AccountRoles = (at:datetime) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        datatable(AccountKey:string, Role:string, Basis:string)[]
    ),
    (
        IdentityInfo
        | where TimeGenerated between ((at - 14d) .. at)
        | extend Sam = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("SAMAccountName", "")), AccountName)),
            Upn = tolower(coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUPN", "")), tostring(column_ifexists("AccountUpn", "")))),
            EntraRoles = tostring(column_ifexists("AssignedRoles", dynamic([]))),
            Groups = tostring(column_ifexists("GroupMembership", dynamic([]))),
            IsSvc = tobool(column_ifexists("IsServiceAccount", false)),
            IdTags = tostring(column_ifexists("Tags", ""))
        | where isnotempty(Sam)
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Upn, EntraRoles, Groups, IsSvc, IdTags) by Sam
        | extend Roles = pack_array(
            iff(EntraRoles in ("", "[]", "null"), "", "Entra ID role assigned"),
            iff(Groups has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators",
                    "Server Operators", "Admins du domaine", "Administrateurs de l'entreprise", "Administrateurs du schéma",
                    "Opérateurs de compte", "Opérateurs de sauvegarde", "Opérateurs de serveur"), "Privileged AD group", ""),
            iff(IsSvc, "Service account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has_any ("Sensitive", "Sensible"), "Sensitive account", ""),
            iff(IdTags has "Honeytoken", "Honeytoken account", ""))
        | mv-expand Role = Roles to typeof(string)
        | where isnotempty(Role)
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Sam, Upn) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role, Basis = "IdentityInfo"
    ),
    (
        Watchlist
        | where WatchlistAlias =~ "EasyPivotRoles" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
        | summarize arg_max(_DTTimestamp, _DTItemStatus, WatchlistItem) by _DTItemId
        | where _DTItemStatus != "Deleted"
        | where tolower(tostring(WatchlistItem.Type)) in ("compte", "account", "user", "utilisateur")
        | extend Raw = tolower(trim(@"\s", tostring(WatchlistItem.Entity)))
        | mv-expand AccountKey = pack_array(Raw, _SamOf(Raw)) to typeof(string)
        | project AccountKey, Role = tostring(WatchlistItem.Role), Basis = strcat("Watchlist EasyPivotRoles ", tostring(WatchlistItem.Note))
    )
    | where isnotempty(AccountKey) and isnotempty(Role)
    | summarize AccountRoles = make_set(Role), AccountRoleBasis = make_set(Basis, 5) by AccountKey
    | project AccountKey, AccountRole = strcat_array(AccountRoles, ", "), AccountRoleBasis
};

let _SysmonEventName = (id:int) {

union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where SHA256 == ValueHash or SHA1 == ValueHash or MD5 == ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DeviceName startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName = tolower(DeviceName), FolderPath, FileName, Action = strcat("File ", ActionType),
        Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Process = InitiatingProcessFileName
),
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where SHA256 == ValueHash or SHA1 == ValueHash or MD5 == ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DeviceName startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName = tolower(DeviceName), FolderPath, FileName, Action = "Executed",
        Account = tolower(AccountName), Process = InitiatingProcessFileName
),
(
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where SHA256 == ValueHash or SHA1 == ValueHash or MD5 == ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DeviceName startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName = tolower(DeviceName), FolderPath, FileName, Action = "Loaded (DLL)",
        Account = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountName), Process = InitiatingProcessFileName
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    ASimFileEventLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where TargetFileSHA256 =~ ValueHash or TargetFileSHA1 =~ ValueHash or TargetFileMD5 =~ ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DvcHostname startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName = tolower(DvcHostname), FolderPath = TargetFilePath, FileName = TargetFileName,
        Action = strcat("File ", EventType, " (ASIM)"), Account = tolower(ActorUsername), Process = ActingProcessName
),
(
    ASimProcessEventLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where TargetProcessSHA256 =~ ValueHash or TargetProcessSHA1 =~ ValueHash or TargetProcessMD5 =~ ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DvcHostname startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName = tolower(DvcHostname), FolderPath = TargetProcessName, FileName = TargetProcessFilename,
        Action = "Executed (ASIM)", Account = tolower(ActorUsername), Process = ActingProcessFilename
),
(
    _Sysmon(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([1, 7, 15, 23, 26, 29]), ValueHash)
    | where SHA256 == ValueHash or SHA1 == ValueHash or MD5 == ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Computer startswith HostFilter
    | extend Path = case(EventID == 1, Image, EventID == 7, ImageLoaded, TargetFilename)
    | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName = tolower(Computer), FolderPath = Path, FileName = tolower(tostring(split(Path, @"\")[-1])),
        Action = strcat(EventName, " (Sysmon)"), Account = UserSam, Process = iff(EventID == 1, ParentFile, ProcessFile)
