// @sentinel-only:end
| summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Actions = make_set(Action),
    Accounts = make_set(Account, 5), Processes = make_set(Process, 5) by DeviceName, FolderPath, FileName
| extend MachineKey = _HostKey(DeviceName)
| lookup kind=leftouter (_MachineRoles(EndTimestamp)) on MachineKey
| project-away MachineKey, MachineRoleBasis
| sort by FirstSeen asc

rules.name: Origin of the file
rules.description: Where the file comes from: URL, referrer and origin IP of the download, process that wrote it (browser, Outlook, archiver) and, if it arrived by email, sender, recipient and subject. In Sentinel, downloads seen by the proxy (ASimWebSessionLogs, CommonSecurityLog) complement Defender for Endpoint when the workstation is not covered, as does the Zone.Identifier stream (Mark of the Web) logged by Sysmon 15, which gives the URL and referrer of the download. The HOST context narrows the search to one device.

reading.decisive: Origin URL on a recent or typosquatted domain, advertising referrer, or attachment from a new sender.
reading.context: File extracted from an archive (written by 7z.exe, WinRAR or explorer.exe).
reading.noise: Downloads from official vendor sites.

rules.query:
// [HS-P2] Origin of the file — Pivot / Hash
// sentinel-pivot-rules 0.2.0. Parameters: {{VALUE}}, {{T0}}, {{BEFORE_MIN}}, {{AFTER_MIN}}, {{HOST}}
let Value = trim(@"\s", @"{{VALUE}}");
let T0 = coalesce(todatetime(@"{{T0}}"), now());
let Before = coalesce(tolong(@"{{BEFORE_MIN}}"), 10080) * 1m; // default: 7d
let After = coalesce(tolong(@"{{AFTER_MIN}}"), 60) * 1m; // default: 1h
let StartTimestamp = T0 - Before;
let EndTimestamp = T0 + After;
let HostFilter = tolower(tostring(split(trim(@"\s", iff(@"{{HOST}}" startswith "{{", "", @"{{HOST}}")), ".")[0]));
// Hash indicator: MD5 (32), SHA1 (40) or SHA256 (64).
let ValueHash = tolower(Value);
// Sysmon events (Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational log) normalized, whatever the ingestion table:
// Event (Azure Monitor agent, EventData as XML) or WindowsEvent (event forwarding, EventData as JSON).
// Parameters: start, end, ids (EventIDs, empty = all), term (text pre-filter on event data and device name, empty = none).
// Sysmon columns (Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, User, Hashes, TargetFilename, ImageLoaded, TargetObject, Details,
// SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname, QueryName, QueryResults...) and derived columns:
// Contents (Zone.Identifier stream of event 15: HostUrl and ReferrerUrl of the download).
// ProcessFile, ParentFile, TargetFile (lowercase file names), UserSam, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, RegistryEventType, EventName.
// Sentinel-only fragment: removed from the Defender variant (rules call it inside @sentinel-only blocks).
// Returns nothing unless Sysmon is installed with a configuration that logs the requested EventIDs.
// @sentinel-only:begin
let _SysmonEventName = (id:int) {
    case(
        id == 1, "Process created",
        id == 2, "File creation time changed",
        id == 3, "Network connection",
        id == 5, "Process terminated",
        id == 6, "Driver loaded",
        id == 7, "Image (DLL) loaded",
        id == 8, "Remote thread created",
        id == 10, "Process accessed",
        id == 11, "File created",
        id == 12, "Registry key created or deleted",
        id == 13, "Registry value set",
        id == 14, "Registry key or value renamed",
        id == 15, "File stream created (ADS, Mark of the Web)",
        id == 17, "Named pipe created",
        id == 18, "Named pipe connected",
        id == 22, "DNS query",
        id == 23, "File deleted (archived)",
        id == 25, "Process tampering",
        id == 26, "File deleted",
        id == 29, "Executable detected",
        strcat("Sysmon ", tostring(id)))
};
let _Sysmon = (start:datetime, end:datetime, ids:dynamic, term:string) {
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        Event
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or EventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = EventData
        | extend
            Image = extract(@'<Data Name="Image">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            CommandLine = extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            CurrentDirectory = extract(@'<Data Name="CurrentDirectory">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ProcessGuid = extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessGuid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ProcessId = extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            User = extract(@'<Data Name="User">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ParentImage = extract(@'<Data Name="ParentImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ParentCommandLine = extract(@'<Data Name="ParentCommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ParentProcessGuid = extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessGuid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Hashes = extract(@'<Data Name="Hashes">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Hash = extract(@'<Data Name="Hash">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            OriginalFileName = extract(@'<Data Name="OriginalFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Company = extract(@'<Data Name="Company">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            IntegrityLevel = extract(@'<Data Name="IntegrityLevel">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetFilename = extract(@'<Data Name="TargetFilename">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            CreationUtcTime = extract(@'<Data Name="CreationUtcTime">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            ImageLoaded = extract(@'<Data Name="ImageLoaded">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Signed = extract(@'<Data Name="Signed">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Signature = extract(@'<Data Name="Signature">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetObject = extract(@'<Data Name="TargetObject">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Details = extract(@'<Data Name="Details">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            EventType = extract(@'<Data Name="EventType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Protocol = extract(@'<Data Name="Protocol">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Initiated = extract(@'<Data Name="Initiated">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            SourceIp = extract(@'<Data Name="SourceIp">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            SourcePort = extract(@'<Data Name="SourcePort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            SourceHostname = extract(@'<Data Name="SourceHostname">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            DestinationIp = extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationIp">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            DestinationPort = extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            DestinationHostname = extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationHostname">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            QueryName = extract(@'<Data Name="QueryName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            QueryResults = extract(@'<Data Name="QueryResults">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            QueryStatus = extract(@'<Data Name="QueryStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            SourceImage = extract(@'<Data Name="SourceImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            TargetImage = extract(@'<Data Name="TargetImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            GrantedAccess = extract(@'<Data Name="GrantedAccess">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Archived = extract(@'<Data Name="Archived">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x),
            Contents = extract(@'<Data Name="Contents">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)
        | extend SourceTable = "Event"
    ),
    (
        WindowsEvent
        | where TimeGenerated between (start .. end)
        | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon"
        | where array_length(ids) == 0 or EventID in (ids)
        | where isempty(term) or tostring(EventData) has term or RawEventData has term or Computer has term
        | extend _x = tostring(RawEventData)
        | extend
            Image = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Image), extract(@'<Data Name="Image">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="CommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CurrentDirectory = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CurrentDirectory), extract(@'<Data Name="CurrentDirectory">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessGuid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessGuid), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessGuid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ProcessId = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ProcessId), extract(@'<Data Name="ProcessId">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            User = coalesce(tostring(EventData.User), extract(@'<Data Name="User">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentImage = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentImage), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentCommandLine = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentCommandLine), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentCommandLine">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ParentProcessGuid = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ParentProcessGuid), extract(@'<Data Name="ParentProcessGuid">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Hashes = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Hashes), extract(@'<Data Name="Hashes">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Hash = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Hash), extract(@'<Data Name="Hash">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            OriginalFileName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.OriginalFileName), extract(@'<Data Name="OriginalFileName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Company = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Company), extract(@'<Data Name="Company">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            IntegrityLevel = coalesce(tostring(EventData.IntegrityLevel), extract(@'<Data Name="IntegrityLevel">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetFilename = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetFilename), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetFilename">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            CreationUtcTime = coalesce(tostring(EventData.CreationUtcTime), extract(@'<Data Name="CreationUtcTime">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            ImageLoaded = coalesce(tostring(EventData.ImageLoaded), extract(@'<Data Name="ImageLoaded">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Signed = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Signed), extract(@'<Data Name="Signed">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Signature = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Signature), extract(@'<Data Name="Signature">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetObject = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetObject), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetObject">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Details = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Details), extract(@'<Data Name="Details">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            EventType = coalesce(tostring(EventData.EventType), extract(@'<Data Name="EventType">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Protocol = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Protocol), extract(@'<Data Name="Protocol">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Initiated = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Initiated), extract(@'<Data Name="Initiated">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SourceIp = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SourceIp), extract(@'<Data Name="SourceIp">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SourcePort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SourcePort), extract(@'<Data Name="SourcePort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SourceHostname = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SourceHostname), extract(@'<Data Name="SourceHostname">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            DestinationIp = coalesce(tostring(EventData.DestinationIp), extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationIp">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            DestinationPort = coalesce(tostring(EventData.DestinationPort), extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationPort">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            DestinationHostname = coalesce(tostring(EventData.DestinationHostname), extract(@'<Data Name="DestinationHostname">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            QueryName = coalesce(tostring(EventData.QueryName), extract(@'<Data Name="QueryName">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            QueryResults = coalesce(tostring(EventData.QueryResults), extract(@'<Data Name="QueryResults">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            QueryStatus = coalesce(tostring(EventData.QueryStatus), extract(@'<Data Name="QueryStatus">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            SourceImage = coalesce(tostring(EventData.SourceImage), extract(@'<Data Name="SourceImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            TargetImage = coalesce(tostring(EventData.TargetImage), extract(@'<Data Name="TargetImage">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            GrantedAccess = coalesce(tostring(EventData.GrantedAccess), extract(@'<Data Name="GrantedAccess">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Archived = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Archived), extract(@'<Data Name="Archived">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x)),
            Contents = coalesce(tostring(EventData.Contents), extract(@'<Data Name="Contents">([^<]*)</Data>', 1, _x))
        | extend SourceTable = "WindowsEvent"
    )
    | extend Hashes = coalesce(Hashes, Hash)
    | extend ProcessFile = tolower(tostring(split(Image, @"\")[-1])), ParentFile = tolower(tostring(split(ParentImage, @"\")[-1])),
        TargetFile = tolower(tostring(split(TargetFilename, @"\")[-1])), UserSam = tolower(tostring(split(User, @"\")[-1])),
        SHA256 = tolower(extract(@"SHA256=([0-9A-Fa-f]{64})", 1, Hashes)), SHA1 = tolower(extract(@"SHA1=([0-9A-Fa-f]{40})", 1, Hashes)),
        MD5 = tolower(extract(@"MD5=([0-9A-Fa-f]{32})", 1, Hashes)), EventName = _SysmonEventName(EventID), RegistryEventType = EventType
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceTable, Computer, EventID, EventName, Image, ProcessFile, CommandLine, CurrentDirectory, ProcessGuid, ProcessId,
        User, UserSam, ParentImage, ParentFile, ParentCommandLine, ParentProcessGuid, Hashes, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, OriginalFileName, Company,
        IntegrityLevel, TargetFilename, TargetFile, CreationUtcTime, ImageLoaded, Signed, Signature, TargetObject, Details, RegistryEventType,
        Protocol, Initiated, SourceIp, SourcePort, SourceHostname, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname, QueryName, QueryResults,
        QueryStatus, SourceImage, TargetImage, GrantedAccess, Archived, Contents
};
// @sentinel-only:end
union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where SHA256 == ValueHash or SHA1 == ValueHash or MD5 == ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or DeviceName startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "DeviceFileEvents", Where = tolower(DeviceName), FileName, FolderPath,
        OriginUrl = FileOriginUrl, Referrer = FileOriginReferrerUrl, OriginIP = FileOriginIP,
        Via = strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " · ", InitiatingProcessCommandLine), Detail = ActionType
),
(
    EmailAttachmentInfo
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where SHA256 == ValueHash
    | join kind=leftouter (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
        | project NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, DeliveryAction, SenderIPv4
        ) on NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "EmailAttachmentInfo", Where = tolower(RecipientEmailAddress), FileName, FolderPath = "",
        OriginUrl = "", Referrer = "", OriginIP = SenderIPv4, Via = strcat("Email from ", SenderFromAddress),
        Detail = strcat(Subject, " · ", DeliveryAction, " · ", ThreatTypes)
)
// @sentinel-only:begin
, (
    ASimWebSessionLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where FileSHA256 =~ ValueHash or FileSHA1 =~ ValueHash or FileMD5 =~ ValueHash
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("ASimWebSessionLogs (", EventProduct, ")"), Where = tolower(coalesce(SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr)),
        FileName, FolderPath = "", OriginUrl = Url, Referrer = HttpReferrer, OriginIP = DstIpAddr,
        Via = strcat("Proxy · ", SrcUsername, " · ", HttpUserAgent), Detail = strcat(DvcAction, " ", EventResult)
),
(
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (StartTimestamp .. EndTimestamp)
    | where FileHash =~ ValueHash
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = strcat("CommonSecurityLog (", DeviceVendor, ")"), Where = tolower(coalesce(SourceHostName, SourceIP)),
        FileName, FolderPath = FilePath, OriginUrl = RequestURL, Referrer = "", OriginIP = DestinationIP,
        Via = strcat(DeviceProduct, " · ", SourceUserName), Detail = coalesce(DeviceAction, Activity)
),
(
    _Sysmon(StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp, dynamic([15]), ValueHash)
    | where SHA256 == ValueHash or SHA1 == ValueHash or MD5 == ValueHash
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Computer startswith HostFilter
    | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Sysmon 15 (Zone.Identifier)", Where = tolower(Computer), FileName = TargetFile, FolderPath = TargetFilename,
        OriginUrl = extract(@"HostUrl=(\S+)", 1, Contents), Referrer = extract(@"ReferrerUrl=(\S+)", 1, Contents), OriginIP = "",
        Via = strcat(ProcessFile, " · ", UserSam), Detail = strcat("Zone ", extract(@"ZoneId=(\d)", 1, Contents))
)
// @sentinel-only:end
| sort by TimeGenerated asc

scenarios.name: Suspicious sign-in from an IP
scenarios.description: Qualify an IP seen in a sign-in alert: its nature (NAT, VPN, hosting provider, internal), the accounts that used it, then the sign-in habits and actions of the most exposed account.

scenarios.name: Password spray or brute force
scenarios.description: An IP piling up authentication failures: how many accounts it targets and when, which ones eventually succeeded, then the failure profile and Entra risk of the first account reached.

scenarios.name: Account flagged at risk by Entra ID
scenarios.description: An Identity Protection alert: detections and risk state, sign-in habits, IPs used, then the nature of the suspicious IP and the other accounts using it.

scenarios.name: Data exfiltration by an account
scenarios.description: A departing employee or an account suspected of leaking data: files and shares read, actions on cloud files, messages sent, IPs used, then the cloud services reached from the most unusual IP.

scenarios.name: Suspicious outbound traffic from a device
scenarios.description: A device talking to destinations nobody else contacts: the rarest destination, its prevalence, the other devices and processes reaching it, then the timeline of one of them.

scenarios.name: Compromised account
scenarios.description: After an alert on an account: profile and roles, IPs and devices used, persistence in the mailbox and the directory (forwarding rules, consents, MFA), then the devices reached and their timeline.

scenarios.name: Suspicious execution on a device
scenarios.description: A flagged device: role and identity, accounts that logged on, files downloaded then executed, presence of the file elsewhere in the tenant, persistence installed.

scenarios.name: Phishing
scenarios.description: A reported message: the sender's messages, their URLs and attachments, the users who clicked, then what the first of them did.

scenarios.name: Malicious domain
scenarios.description: A domain flagged by threat intelligence: its prevalence, the devices and processes that contacted it, then the timeline of the most exposed device.

scenarios.name: Lateral movement from a device
scenarios.description: A compromised device is the starting point: who logged on to it, which other devices that account went to next, what it read or wrote there, and the timeline of the device reached.

scenarios.name: Malicious file
scenarios.description: A hash flagged by the antivirus or threat intelligence: its prevalence in the tenant, where it came from (URL, email, IP), the devices that have it, then the persistence and timeline of one of them.

scenarios.name: Malicious OAuth consent
scenarios.description: A suspicious third-party application (consent phishing): who granted it which permissions, what its service principal does, which accounts use it, then what those accounts changed in their mailbox and the directory.

scenarios.name: Beaconing to a C2 server
scenarios.description: An external IP contacted at regular intervals: its nature, the process calling it (and how regular the connections are), its parent/child chain, what it changed to persist and its timeline.
